Bei Interesse ist es möglich, fast vollständig remote zu arbeiten.Deine Aufgaben• Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung unserer cloudbasierten unternehmensweiten Snowflake Datenplattform durch Bereitstellung und Verwaltung von Snowflake-Accounts und Beratung unserer Kunden zu deren Verwendung• Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung und Wartung von ETL-Prozessen zur Datenintegration, sowie Monitoring und Performanceoptimierung der Datenstrecken und Analysen• Zusammenarbeit mit Data Scientisten, Data Engineers und Analysten zur Bereitstellung von Datenlösungen• Konzipieren, Implementieren und überwachen von IT-Sicherheits- und Governance-Richtlinien• Integration von Künstlicher Intelligenz in unsere Analytics-Prozesse und -Anwendungen sowie Unterstützung des Teams bei der 24/7 Rufbereitschaft• Realisierung von Projekten als technischer ProjektleiterDas bringst Du mit• Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbar, eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker oder ein Quereinstieg mit mehrjähriger Berufserfahrung im Server- & Cloud-Administrationsumfeld• Erfahrung im Umgang mit Linux- & Windows-basierten Systemen und Datenbanken insb. Snowflake, sowie Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung und Orchestrierung von Cloud-Infrastrukturen• Leidenschaft und Begeisterung für neue Technologien und Themen rund um Künstliche Intelligenz, Snowflake & Cloud (GCP, AWS, Azure)• Die Fähigkeit und den Willen, sich immer wieder neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen und dabei eigenverantwortlich Themen zu gestalten und voranzutreiben• Ausgeprägtes Kommunikationsvermögen auf Deutsch (mind. C1)Das bieten wir Dir• Dialogische Unternehmenskultur: Individuelle Stärken und Ideen unserer Mitarbeitenden sind das Fundament für die (Weiter-)Entwicklung unserer IT-Produkte. Dabei gehen wir offen mit neuen Technologien um, testen und nutzen dabei aktiv unsere Entscheidungsspielräume für ein optimales Ergebnis.• Gesundheit & Vorsorge: Für Deine Vorsorge bieten wir unterschiedliche Zusatzleistungen für individuelle Bedürfnisse an: von einem Zuschuss zu Deiner betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, einer attraktiven Berufsunfähigkeitsversicherung über Angebote für Deine physische und psychische Gesundheit bis hin zu Kooperationen mit Krankenkassen oder Fitness-Studios und hausinternen Kursen für Dein Wohlbefinden. Ein betriebliches Sozialmanagement rundet das Angebot ab.• Lernen bei dmTECH: Die digitale dm-Lernwelt bietet Dir zeit- und ortsunabhängig über 250 Seminare und Workshops – vom Projektmanagement bis hin zu fachlichen Weiterbildungen. Du hast Zugang zur Lernplattform Udemy mit ihrem breit gefächerten Kursangebot und kannst zusätzlich an externen Events und Weiterbildungen teilnehmen.• Für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance: flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten, 37,5-Stunden-Woche und 30 Urlaubstage. Bei einer „Workation“ kannst Du sogar Urlaub und Arbeit verbinden.• Arbeitsatmosphäre: Unsere Räume im „dialogicum" sind hell, großzügig und modern. Die neueste Technik und ergonomisches Mobiliar erleichtern Dir Deine Aufgaben. Im „culinarium" bieten wir Dir täglich frische Mahlzeiten, gesunde Snacks und süße Kleinigkeiten zum fairen Preis.• Zusatzleistungen: Den Erfolg unserer Arbeitsgemeinschaft geben wir gern an Dich zurück – mit Zulagen wie Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld, mit Sonderzahlungen und Warengutscheinen. Du bekommst außerdem 10 % Mitarbeiterrabatt in allen deutschen dm-Märkten und profitierst in vielen Onlineshops von exklusiven Angeboten für dm-Mitarbeitende. Darüber hinaus kannst Du zweimal jährlich aktuelle Smartphones, Tablets oder Laptops für Deinen Privatgebrauch preiswert leasen.• Mobilität: Mit einem Zuschuss für das "Deutschlandticket Job" bist Du günstig unterwegs. Wenn Du lieber Fahrrad fährst, kannst Du auch das JobRad® nutzen. Auf unserem Gelände gibt es genügend Parkplätze, E-Ladestationen und eine Fahrradgarage. Eine S-Bahn-Station und der Anschluss zur Autobahn liegen in direkter Nähe.

title: Consulent Werving & Selectie
description: - Je spreekt vloeiend Slowaaks en Pools en kunt je ook goed redden in het Nederlands of Engels voor overleg met collega's op kantoor. Beheersing Duitse taal is een pré.- Je hebt recente ervaring in de uitzendbranche of in internationale werving en selectie.- Je bent communicatief sterk, schakelt snel en hebt een goede dosis mensenkennis.- Je handelt pro-actief en gaat zelf actief opzoek naar kandidaten door verschillende social media kanalen en websites.- Je werkt zelfstandig en pakt graag zelf contact op met opdrachtgevers over aanvragen.- Je hebt ambitie om jezelf op korte termijn verder te ontwikkelen richting een coördinerende rol.- Geen minimale opleidingseisen, we kijken vooral naar wie je bent en wat je al hebt laten zien.Ben jij degene die moeiteloos schakelt tussen Slowaaks, Pools en Nederlands (of Engels) en krijg je energie van het opbouwen van een sterke flexpool? Dan hebben we bij Light Personeelsdiensten in Rotterdam een mooie uitdaging voor je.We groeien hard. Daardoor breiden we onze wervingsteams uit en zoeken we iemand die de Slowaakse en Poolse markt kent of de talen vloeiend spreekt en snapt wat er speelt bij kandidaten uit die landen. Je komt te werken in een hecht team waar korte lijnen geen loze kreet zijn maar de dagelijkse praktijk.Als Consulent Werving & Selectie ben jij straks het eerste aanspreekpunt voor nieuwe en bestaande kandidaten/ medewerkers. Je zet vacatures uit via de juiste internationale kanalen, voert intakegesprekken en zorgt dat mensen precies weten waar ze aan beginnen voordat ze op de werkvloer staan. Je bouwt stabiele flexpools op, houdt contact met je kandidaten en regelt dat alles administratief klopt.Bij onze organisatie werken wij als een team. Je komt de planner regelmatig tegen voor afstemming maar krijgt ook de ruimte om zelf contact te onderhouden met opdrachtgevers en aanvragen zelfstandig op te pakken en te organiseren. Dus heb je een proactieve instelling en wil je meer dan alleen werven? Dan pas je hier goed.Op termijn is er concreet uitzicht op doorgroei naar een coördinerende rol. We investeren liever in mensen die willen groeien dan dat we steeds nieuwe mensen zoeken.

title: Information Security Officer (Junior)
description: JBT Marel is seeking an Information security officer (Junior).Purpose:The Information Security Officer is part of the Information Security department within JBT Marel. The Information Security department is responsible for both Risk Management and Security Operations. The Information Security Officer supports the implementation and continuous improvement of JBT Marel’s security framework across the business. The role acts as a security liaison between business, technology and security teams and provides practical, risk-aligned guidance within assigned areas of responsibility.It is your mission to help identify, assess and document security risks across information, processes, projects and technologies, and to support the mitigation of those risks. You know how to collaborate with stakeholders, communicate clearly, and balance security requirements with business value and usability. for facilities, utilities, equipment, and computer systems (CSV).• Serve as a Quality representative and a subject matter expert (SME) in selection, design and build of new technologies and new facilities within Alvotech.• Support and provide QA oversight with review and approval of qualification documents for facility, utility, equipment and computerized systems as applicable.• Contribute to investigations into discrepancies arising during qualification / validation activities and subsequent approval of appropriate corrective actions.• Review of planned and unplanned work orders for equipment, computer systems.• Stay current on applicable external requirements and industry standards and drive continuousimprovement on engineering and CSV processes and tools.• Advice on quality Management of Alvotech• Responsible for ensuring all facilities, utilities, equipment, computer systems are appropriately validated and qualification in line with current EU and US legislation for parenteral/biologics.Minimum education and experience required for the role:• A bachelor's degree within relevant area, or other relevant business experience• Minimum 5 years of experience within the Pharmaceutical or Medical Device Industry (preferably in parenteral/biologics formulations).• Experience working with regulatory requirements in GxP required (Preferably FDA and EU regulations).• Good understanding of GAMP 5 guide required.• Knowledge of and experience with validation and qualification specifically within facility, utility, and equipment/computer systems.What we offer:•     An inspiring challenge to work with great co-workers on ambitious projects that change people's lives.•       The chance to be a part of a global and fast-growing company.•       An international work Company social events and milestone celebrations.•       Excellent in-house canteen and coffee house.•       Exercise and wellbeing support for full-time employees.•       On-site shower facility.•       Transportation grant towards eco-friendly modes of travel for full-time employees.•       Internet at home for full-time employees.About Us: At Alvotech, we are building a global biotechnology company with a clear purpose: to expand access to high-quality, affordable biologic medicines for patients worldwide. Across our global teams, we bring together expertise in science, manufacturing, quality and commercial operations to shape the future of biosimilars.We offer a dynamic, fast-moving environment where curiosity, initiative and ownership are encouraged. Rooted in Icelandic values and operating on a global stage, we value collaboration, diversity and integrity across everything we do. Our teams work on meaningful challenges, contribute directly to patient impact, and grow alongside the business.Whether you are at the start of your career or looking to take your next step, Alvotech offers the opportunity to do work that matters, in a company driven by purpose and scale.If you do not see a role that matches your experience today, we still welcome general applications from individuals who share our ambition and want to help improve access to biologic medicines worldwide.Please contact: hr@alvotech.com to apply for the position. title: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍK
description: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍKAre you ready to make your mark on one of Iceland’s most exciting culinary destinations?We are seeking a creative and ambitious Head Chef for a well-established fine dining restaurant in Reykjavík. Selected by the MICHELIN Guide, the restaurant offers contemporary Icelandic cuisine with strong roots in the country’s culinary heritage.This is a rare opportunity to lead a dedicated kitchen team, develop your own culinary direction and work with some of the Nordic region’s most distinctive ingredients.ABOUT THE RESTAURANTThe restaurant serves modern Icelandic cuisine, with seasonality, sustainability and local ingredients at its heart. The menus evolve with the seasons, showcasing the best Iceland has to offer—from fish, shellfish and lamb to wild herbs, seaweed and produce from local suppliers.The restaurant has recently moved to new premises with a larger, upgraded kitchen. The incoming Head Chef will have considerable creative freedom to develop the menus and help shape the restaurant’s future culinary direction.THE ROLEAs Head Chef, you will have overall responsibility for the kitchen’s culinary direction and operations. You will lead the team in its daily work, ensuring consistently exceptional standards throughout every service.Your responsibilities will include:    Leading, developing and motivating the kitchen team    Creating seasonal menus    Maintaining quality and consistency throughout every service    Establishing clear planning, structure and efficient kitchen workflows    Working closely with local, sustainably sourced ingredients    Further developing the restaurant’s identity and culinary direction    Creating a professional, safe and inclusive kitchen cultureWHO WE ARE LOOKING FORWe are looking for a creative, ambitious chef who is confident in a professional kitchen. You have a strong fine dining background and understand the precision, quality and attention to the overall guest experience expected at MICHELIN Guide level.You may already be working as a Head Chef, or you may be an outstanding Sous Chef ready to take the next step into a leadership role.We believe you bring:    Substantial experience in fine dining or another high-level culinary environment    Experience in menu development and working with seasonal ingredients    A clear, hands-on leadership style    The ability to bring structure, quality and a positive working atmosphere to the kitchen    A genuine interest in sustainability and local ingredients    The ability to balance creativity with quality, financial discipline and reliable operations    Strong communication skills in an international working environmentExperience at a Michelin restaurant or an equivalent culinary level is an advantage, but potential, leadership and ambition can be equally important.A KITCHEN WITH A STRONG TRADITION OF WOMEN IN GASTRONOMYFor the past ten years, the restaurant’s kitchen has been staffed by an all-female team. The restaurant is deeply committed to supporting women in gastronomy and creating opportunities for female chefs to develop into leaders.We want to continue building a workplace where women can grow, make an impact and take on culinary leadership roles. We welcome qualified applicants of all genders and select candidates based on their skills, leadership, motivation and potential.WHAT’S ON OFFER    A key leadership role at a restaurant recommended by the MICHELIN Guide    Considerable creative freedom to shape the menus and culinary direction    A larger, recently upgraded restaurant kitchen    Access to unique Icelandic ingredients and local producers    The opportunity to lead and develop an ambitious kitchen team    An international career opportunity in Reykjavík    Accommodation options, discussed individually    Salary, start date and other terms by agreementABOUT REYKJAVÍKReykjavík offers a rare combination of urban creativity, a vibrant restaurant scene and spectacular natural surroundings. The sea, mountains, hot springs and some of the Nordic region’s most exciting ingredients are all close at hand.For the right person, this is more than a new job. It is an opportunity to create something of your own while discovering a new country, a new food culture and a new way of life.HOW TO APPLYThe recruitment process is managed by Wildcard Untap, which helps hospitality businesses find skilled specialists and leaders through proactive search, personal dialogue and professional judgement.Please send your CV and a brief introduction outlining your experience, leadership approach and culinary philosophy to:jobb@wildcarduntap.comPlease use the subject line: “Head Chef – Reykjavík”Applications will be reviewed and interviews held on an ongoing basis. All applications will be treated confidentially.

title: HEADCHEF TILL MICHELIN GUIDE-REKOMMENDERAD RESTAURANG I REYKJAVÍK
description: Är du redo att sätta din egen prägel på en av Islands mest spännande gastronomiska destinationer?Nu söker vi en kreativ och ambitiös Head Chef till en välrenommerad fine dining-restaurang i Reykjavík. Restaurangen är utvald av MICHELIN Guide (2026) och erbjuder samtida isländsk gastronomi med tydliga rötter i landets matkultur.Det här är en sällsynt möjlighet för dig som vill leda ett engagerat köksteam, utveckla en egen kulinarisk riktning och arbeta nära några av Nordens mest särpräglade råvaror.OM RESTAURANGENRestaurangen arbetar med modern isländsk matlagning där säsong, hållbarhet och lokala råvaror står i centrum. Menyerna följer årstiderna och bygger på det bästa som Island har att erbjuda – från fisk, skaldjur och lamm till vilda örter, tång och råvaror från lokala producenter.Verksamheten har nyligen flyttat till nya lokaler med ett större och uppgraderat kök. Den nya kökschefen får därför stor kreativ frihet att utveckla menyerna och vara med och forma restaurangens framtida gastronomiska inriktning.ROLLENSom Head Chef får du det övergripande kulinariska och operativa ansvaret för köket. Verksamheten har ett starkt engagemang för att stödja kvinnor inom gastronomin och skapa möjligheter för kvinnliga kockar att utvecklas till ledare.Vi vill fortsätta bygga en arbetsplats där kvinnor kan växa, påverka och ta plats i gastronomiska ledarroller. Samtidigt välkomnar vi kvalificerade sökande oavsett kön och gör urvalet utifrån kompetens, ledarskap, motivation och potential.DET HÄR ERBJUDS    En central ledarroll på en MICHELIN Guide-rekommenderad restaurang    Stor kreativ frihet att påverka menyer och gastronomisk inriktning    Ett större och nyligen uppgraderat restaurangkök    Tillgång till unika isländska råvaror och lokala producenter    Möjlighet att leda och utveckla ett ambitiöst köksteam    En internationell karriärmöjlighet i Reykjavík    Boendemöjligheter finns och diskuteras individuellt    Lön, startdatum och övriga villkor enligt överenskommelseOM REYKJAVÍKReykjavík erbjuder en ovanlig kombination av kreativ storstad, levande restaurangkultur och storslagen natur. Här finns havet, bergen, varma källor och några av Nordens mest intressanta råvaror alldeles i närheten.För rätt person är detta mer än ett nytt arbete. title: Engineering Manager
description: Fenris Creations is hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the infrastructure engineering team behind EVE Online.EVE runs as a single shared universe, where every player has an opportunity to leave a mark on a 20-year running persistent game experience. Our game cluster spans our own datacenter hardware and AWS. Our tight-knit team owns this infrastructure end-to-end: servers and network gear in the racks, the cloud networks and Golang domain specific services in AWS, and the incident, change management, testing, alerting, automation, and budget processes that keep it all running.You'll lead the engineers who build and run that platform. You'll set technical direction, own reliability and cost, and stay close enough to the work to make good calls during an outage or a hardware refresh. This is a hands-on management role.The role is based in Reykjavík, Iceland. We are a hybrid office, and offer flexibility around which days are in-office and which can be worked remotely.Your Tasks:Lead the teamHire, coach, and grow infrastructure engineers. Run 1:1s, give performance feedback, and guide career growth.Set the team's priorities across new platform work, requests from game teams, operational load, and technical debt.Run planning with product owners and other engineering leads.Own reliabilityRun the incident management process: on-call rotations and expectations, escalation paths, alerting, and blameless postmortems.Guide production change management, setting policy on deployment reviews, maintenance windows, and rollback plans, and so on.Define and track SLIs and SLOs for core services and set team priorities in response.Own the platformGuide architecture for our on-premise datacenter and AWS environments, and how traffic moves between them.Oversee hardware lifecycle: procurement, bare-metal provisioning, firmware and OS updates, and decommissioning.Own network design and security across both environments, from Cisco routers and firewalls to VPCs, Transit Gateways, and access controls.Push for automation wherever possible, in provisioning, configuration, CI/CD, and observability, to minimize engineering TOIL.Own the budgetSet the cloud and on-premise infrastructure budgets, and forecast spend as the game grows.Manage vendor relationships and contracts with cloud, datacenter, CDN, and tooling providers.Find and deliver cost savings without trading away reliability.Your Profile:Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.8+ years in infrastructure, systems, site reliability, or distributed systems engineering.2+ years managing engineers directly, including hiring and performance management.Strong grasp of distributed systems — message queues, service discovery, consistency, failure modes, and how to debug them in production.Hands-on experience running physical hardware in a datacenter — bare-metal provisioning, server and storage lifecycle, and working with colocation providers.Deep cloud provider experience, especially in networking and security (VPCs, Transit Gateways, routing, security groups) and running services at scale.Solid networking fundamentals — TCP/IP, routing protocols such as BGP, VLANs, firewalls, and router configuration.Experience leading incident response and building on-call and postmortem practices.Comfort reading and reviewing code in Golang or Python.Experience owning or forecasting an infrastructure budget.Strong technical writing and spoken communication skills in English — design docs, tradeoff analyses — and a track record of driving complex, cross-functional technical projects across multiple project and executive stakeholders.Nice to have:Experience with RabbitMQ, NATS, or other message brokers in production.Experience with DynamoDB and Redis.Automation with Python and Ansible.Bare-metal provisioning with PXE boot, Tinkerbell, or similar tools.Infrastructure as code with Terraform, and CI/CD with TeamCity or GitHub Actions.Observability tooling such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or Honeycomb.Background in game services or other low-latency, high-concurrency systems.Experience with hybrid on-premise and cloud environments, or migrations between them.Our stackOur cloud platform is a set of Golang microservices in AWS, built around a service gateway and RabbitMQ message queues. On-premise, we run our own servers and Cisco network gear in the datacenter, managed with Ansible and Python.Area.Tools.Languages.Golang, Python.Messaging.RabbitMQ, NATS.Data.DynamoDB, Redis.Cloud.AWS (VPCs, Transit Gateways, EKS).Datacenter.Cisco routers, PXE boot, Ansible.Automation and CI/CD.Terraform, TeamCity.What We Can Offer You:The chance to work on EVE Online with talented, ambitious colleagues.A multicultural workplace that encourages growth and new ideas.Dual-monitor workstation and a flexible work environment.An active fun division that hosts regular events.A canteen with weekly breakfast and lunch menus, plus drinks and snacks.Discretionary quarterly and annual. performance sharing plan.Annual sports grant.Mobile phone and mobile plan.Home internet.Conditional monthly transportation grant.Free on-site doctor and other on-site. services at a discount.Relocation package.Please submit your application in English by filling in an online application here: https://careers.fenris.com/en/postings/29d70840-8361-4fc9-ac2a-de524d85fba0

title: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍK
description: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍKAre you ready to make your mark on one of Iceland’s most exciting culinary destinations?We are seeking a creative and ambitious Head Chef for a well-established fine dining restaurant in Reykjavík. Selected by the MICHELIN Guide, the restaurant offers contemporary Icelandic cuisine with strong roots in the country’s culinary heritage.This is a rare opportunity to lead a dedicated kitchen team, develop your own culinary direction and work with some of the Nordic region’s most distinctive ingredients.ABOUT THE RESTAURANTThe restaurant serves modern Icelandic cuisine, with seasonality, sustainability and local ingredients at its heart. The menus evolve with the seasons, showcasing the best Iceland has to offer—from fish, shellfish and lamb to wild herbs, seaweed and produce from local suppliers.The restaurant has recently moved to new premises with a larger, upgraded kitchen. The incoming Head Chef will have considerable creative freedom to develop the menus and help shape the restaurant’s future culinary direction.THE ROLEAs Head Chef, you will have overall responsibility for the kitchen’s culinary direction and operations. You will lead the team in its daily work, ensuring consistently exceptional standards throughout every service.Your responsibilities will include:    Leading, developing and motivating the kitchen team    Creating seasonal menus    Maintaining quality and consistency throughout every service    Establishing clear planning, structure and efficient kitchen workflows    Working closely with local, sustainably sourced ingredients    Further developing the restaurant’s identity and culinary direction    Creating a professional, safe and inclusive kitchen cultureWHO WE ARE LOOKING FORWe are looking for a creative, ambitious chef who is confident in a professional kitchen. You have a strong fine dining background and understand the precision, quality and attention to the overall guest experience expected at MICHELIN Guide level.You may already be working as a Head Chef, or you may be an outstanding Sous Chef ready to take the next step into a leadership role.We believe you bring:    Substantial experience in fine dining or another high-level culinary environment    Experience in menu development and working with seasonal ingredients    A clear, hands-on leadership style    The ability to bring structure, quality and a positive working atmosphere to the kitchen    A genuine interest in sustainability and local ingredients    The ability to balance creativity with quality, financial discipline and reliable operations    Strong communication skills in an international working environmentExperience at a Michelin restaurant or an equivalent culinary level is an advantage, but potential, leadership and ambition can be equally important.A KITCHEN WITH A STRONG TRADITION OF WOMEN IN GASTRONOMYFor the past ten years, the restaurant’s kitchen has been staffed by an all-female team. The restaurant is deeply committed to supporting women in gastronomy and creating opportunities for female chefs to develop into leaders.We want to continue building a workplace where women can grow, make an impact and take on culinary leadership roles. We welcome qualified applicants of all genders and select candidates based on their skills, leadership, motivation and potential.WHAT’S ON OFFER    A key leadership role at a restaurant recommended by the MICHELIN Guide    Considerable creative freedom to shape the menus and culinary direction    A larger, recently upgraded restaurant kitchen    Access to unique Icelandic ingredients and local producers    The opportunity to lead and develop an ambitious kitchen team    An international career opportunity in Reykjavík    Accommodation options, discussed individually    Salary, start date and other terms by agreementABOUT REYKJAVÍKReykjavík offers a rare combination of urban creativity, a vibrant restaurant scene and spectacular natural surroundings. The sea, mountains, hot springs and some of the Nordic region’s most exciting ingredients are all close at hand.For the right person, this is more than a new job. It is an opportunity to create something of your own while discovering a new country, a new food culture and a new way of life.HOW TO APPLYThe recruitment process is managed by Wildcard Untap, which helps hospitality businesses find skilled specialists and leaders through proactive search, personal dialogue and professional judgement.Please send your CV and a brief introduction outlining your experience, leadership approach and culinary philosophy to:jobb@wildcarduntap.comPlease use the subject line: “Head Chef – Reykjavík”Applications will be reviewed and interviews held on an ongoing basis. All applications will be treated confidentially.

title: Construction - Civil Engineer Intern
description: As a Civil Engineer Intern, you will support multidisciplinary teams delivering water and wastewater projects in office and site environments while building practical skills across project delivery, quality, safety and sustainability. Quality Safety and Sustainability Promote and follow Glanua's health, safety, environmental, quality and sustainability standards, policies and procedures. Learning Collaboration and Development Build familiarity with BIM, Revit and drafting tools and develop an understanding of how digital information supports project delivery. Learn about water and wastewater treatment processes, including potential exposure to modular package treatment plant fabrication. Communicate clearly with colleagues and contribute positively to multidisciplinary project and site teams. Take part in mentoring, continuous learning and feedback.

title: Supervisor – Community Employment (CE)
description: The CE Sponsoring Organisation (Ringsend & District Response to Drugs) is responsible for the terms and conditions of employment of Supervisors as outlined in the CE Procedures Manual. These guidelines are included in the job specification for the CE Supervisor.  Job Title: Supervisor - Community Employment  Reporting to: Project Manager and Chairperson - RDRD Project Management Committee Function: To ensure the effective and efficient management and co-ordination of the human, financial and material resources of the CE Scheme and report to the Project Management Committee on its implementation. A core aspect of the role is to support and coach CE participants towards gaining the skills and competencies in preparation for employment.  Key Result Areas  Administration  • Ensure the provision of an efficient financial and accounting system in line with CE corporate governance requirements as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Ensure that financial returns i.e. wages claims, materials claims, and participant development grant claims meet the standard as laid down by Department of Employment Affairs and Social Protection (DEASP).  • Ensure implementation of systems controlling the operation of all finances e.g. cheque payments book, petty cash system, debtors, creditors and participant’s payroll, bank account and PRSI returns as directed by the Project Management Committee.   • Ensure prompt and accurate payment of participant allowances. Ensure the security of cash/equipment on scheme as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Install and manage effective time keeping record system for participants on scheme.  • Liaise with the local DEASP Office as required.  Training & Development Provision  • Carry out an identification of learner needs with each participant on the scheme as part of the Individual Learner Plan process.  • Identify needs and source and co-ordinate cost effective training/development opportunities in line with DEASP procurement guidelines.  • Prepare an Individual Learning Plan for each Participant for submission to DEASP in accordance with CE procedures.  • Ensure access to recognised qualifications for participants, with a focus on the achievement of relevant qualifications including Major Awards on the National Framework of Qualifications (NFQ) or industry related equivalent. Plan and procure relevant training opportunities which have been approved by DEASP. Maintain and update training records for each participant on the project as part of their Individual Learner Plans. Monitor and review training inputs with the participants. Plan and organise work placements — internal and external as required.  • Report on ILP developments to the Project Management Committee.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie Human Resources  • Co-ordinate the recruitment of CE applicants per the CE Recruitment and Referral Process issued by DEASP.  • Plan and co-ordinate the approved work schedules and ensure contracts of employment are in place for all participants.  • Communicate effectively with all participants on the scheme using team meetings and individual formal and informal 'one-to-one' meetings.  • Develop a mutual understanding with participants in relation to their needs for re-entry to work where the participant had been long-term unemployed and needs to develop a clear progression path. •  Implement job search activities with participants.  • Deal with all disciplinary matters in relation to participants in accordance with DEASP CE procedures. •  Liaise with employers to promote progression to work and work with other support organisations as needed.  • Develop an exit plan with each participant.  • Follow-up and report on participants for up to 4 months on exit from CE.  • Engage in training and development as detailed in Procedures Manual.  • Report to the Project Management Committee as required.  Scheme Management  • Provide a safe and healthy environment for participants - both in terms of facilities and work practices. • Ensure work experience placements on scheme are in line with CE application. Supervise, schedule and manage participants.  • Fully participate in training and development opportunities provided by the Sponsor and by DEASP as required for the post.  • Carry out any other function relevant to the position of Supervisor (Community Employment) as indicated by the Project Management Committee.  Financial Monitoring and Programme and Training Monitoring  • Ensure the CE scheme is compliant with financial, programme and training monitoring requirements as detailed in the CE Operating Procedures.  Progression of CE Participants  • Exit Planning  • Intensive Job Search activities as part of exit planning  • Engagement with Local Employer • Database of Employers  PERSONAL SPECIFICATION  Essential  • Knowledge of post Have a solid understanding of the role of the Community Employment Supervisor as it pertains to project management and programme delivery to long-term unemployed and vulnerable adults. Display responsibility, commitment and motivation to implement the objectives of the Community Employment Programme.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie • Work Experience  Previous supervisory and people management experience relevant to post (3 years minimum). - Previous experience in Administration, Project Management and/or Training or other relevant positions.  • Interpersonal Skills  Effective communication skills. Competent report writing skills. Experience of working with vulnerable individuals and jobseekers. - Capable of directing, motivating, coaching and mentoring jobseekers. Ability to work under the direction of the Sponsoring Organisation for the effective implementation of the CE Programme in line with the CE Operational Procedures.  • Qualifications  Major Award at 3rd Level (NFQ Level 6 or higher) in Business/Financial Administration, Training, Human Resources, Project Management or related disciplines. ICT skills essential (e.g. MS Office) and certification in Addiction Studies ideal. Salary & Benefits • Salary: Aligned with DSP CE Supervisor Scale, commencing at Point 1. Although in the case of a person already employed as a CE supervisor being the successful candidate, they would receive their current rate of pay. • 39 hours per week standard full-time role. • Access to staff support, CISM (Critical Incident Stress Management), and Employee Assistance services. Apply by sending CV to the manager at catherine.meleady@rdrd.ie or by post to the Manager, 17 Irishtown Road, Dublin D04PW10.  Closing date for applications is 5pm on Tuesday 17th of November.

title: Residential Care Worker
description: Are you passionate about making a positive impact on the lives of children? Do you thrive in a dynamic and supportive work environment? We have the perfect opportunity for you! Join our team at Ashdale Care (Ireland), on our journey to transform the lives of young people with complex, emotional and behavioural needs.No two days are the same here in Ashdale Care, this job description is designed to be flexible and adaptable, providing guiding principles for the work rather than strict limitations. It will undergo periodic review to ensure alignment with evolving organisational needs. You will be part of a unique team who will work together to facilitate excellent practice and be part of rebuilding children’s lives. Our vision is for every young person who lives with us to experience a safe, happy and nurturing present and a future that is filled with hope and optimism.Cultivate genuine and caring connections with the young people, always interact with the young people and their families with dignity and respect, promoting a culture of unconditional positive regard.Contribute to the promotion, creation, and maintenance of a welcoming, safe, caring, stable and therapeutic environment.Advocate for the rights and responsibilities of each young person while promoting physical, emotional, social, cultural, ethnic, and spiritual wellbeing.Ensure that young people are not subjected to any forms of abuse and report any concerns according to policy and procedures.Supervise outings from the home and undertake daily household activities such as cooking and cleaning, as part of positive modelling.Actively participate in working within the Model of Therapeutic Care.Be physically able to support with challenging behaviours when needed.Provide emotional support during difficult or stressful times and encourage young people's participation in care planning, placement planning, decision-making and service delivery.Integrate understanding of youth trauma and past experiences into practice through specialised training such as Developmental Trauma and Attachment from the Therapeutic Support Team.Collaborate with support networks, including social workers and educators, guardians and family members.Collaborate effectively within a team, engaging in regular communication through daily handovers, team meetings, and various reviews and planning sessions. Give and receive feedback on performance with colleagues and managers.Maintain consistency in execution of childcare plans.Complete and maintain accurate records and reports for each young person in line with statutory requirements and Ashdale Care policies and procedures.Take on key worker duties including the handling of daily petty cash, accurately documenting receipts, securely storing money and valuable items and serving as a primary point of contact for professionals/family/young person.

title: Care Assistant
description: The Care Assistant plays a key role in supporting adults with intellectual disabilities to live meaningful, fulfilling lives within a warm and inclusive home environment. Working as part of the house team, the Care Assistant provides person-centred support, contributes to the daily life of the house, and fosters positive relationships with Core Members, colleagues, and volunteers.The role involves practical care, emotional support, participation in community life, and collaboration with the House/Team Leader and wider team to ensure high-quality support in line with L’Arche values.Reporting to:House leader / Team Leader / Deputy Team Leader In Relation to the Core Members    Build respectful, trusting, and supportive relationships with each Core Member.    Support Core Members in their daily living activities (personal care, meals, household tasks, etc.) while promoting independence.    Encourage and support Core Members to make choices and take responsibility in their own lives.    Uphold the dignity, self-esteem, and individuality of each person.    Follow care plans and Person-Centred Plans (PCPs) in line with HIQA standards.    Support Core Members in communication, ensuring their voice is heard and respected.    Assist with social, recreational, and community activities in line with Core Members’ interests.    Support Core Members to attend appointments (medical, social, etc.) as required.    Assist in maintaining accurate and confidential records.    Support safe medication practices as directed and trained.    Promote a safe, clean, and healthy living environment. In Relation to the Staff Team    Work collaboratively as part of the house team, supporting a positive and respectful team culture.    Follow guidance from the House/Team Leader and contribute to the smooth running of the house.    Participate in team meetings, training, and reflective practice.    Communicate effectively with colleagues regarding Core Members’ needs and daily updates.    Support new staff and volunteers through welcoming and sharing knowledge of daily routines.    Contribute to a supportive and cooperative team environment.    Attend support and supervision sessions In Relation to Volunteer Assistants    Welcome and include Volunteer Assistants as part of the team.    Support volunteers in understanding their role and the daily life of the house.    Work alongside volunteers to ensure consistent and supportive care for Core Members.    Promote a culture of inclusion, learning, and shared responsibility. In Relation to the House / Community    Actively participate in the daily life and routines of the house.    Support meal preparation, cleaning, and general household tasks.    Contribute to creating a warm, welcoming, and inclusive home environment.    Support celebrations, events, and community gatherings.    Encourage Core Members’ participation in the wider community.    Maintain awareness of health and safety procedures and follow all policies.

title: Marketing Associate
description: JOB SPECIFICATIONMarketing Associate - Coordinator & Content CreatorAbout Great Place to Work® IrelandGreat Place to Work® Ireland is a workplace culture consultancy that helps organisations create high-performing workplaces where employees feel trusted and valued. Using employee feedback, data and international benchmarking, we advise clients on employee experience, engagement and business performance. Our annual Best Workplaces™ awards recognise organisations for their achievements and help them build their employer brands.Our ValuesBring Great to Clients   •   Think Outside the Cube   •   Live a High-Trust CultureCertified Fun   •   Journeying Together   •   Selfcare PractitionersPurpose of the RoleTo plan, coordinate and deliver digital marketing, editorial content, client recognition communications, media engagement and brand campaigns that strengthen Great Place to Work® Ireland’s visibility and support business growth. The role supports a portfolio of approximately 150 clients in activating their recognitions and works closely with colleagues across marketing, client services and business development.Key ResponsibilitiesMarketing Strategy, Brand Campaigns and Growth•    Contribute to marketing growth, brand awareness and lead attraction strategies; identify opportunities and propose innovative initiatives.•    Lead end-to-end planning and delivery of assigned integrated, multi-channel campaigns, including major brand activities such as Certification Nation Day, from briefing and content development through to execution and evaluation.•    Coordinate campaign messaging, client communications, promotional assets, stakeholder input and delivery schedules to support brand positioning and engagement.•    Track campaign performance against agreed objectives and recommend improvements.Content Strategy and Editorial Management•    Manage the editorial content calendar, aligning communications with business priorities, industry developments and key organisational milestones.•    Lead development of client case studies and success stories, coordinating interviews, drafting, stakeholder reviews, feedback and approvals.•    Create and coordinate content for blogs, newsletters, reports, social media and other marketing channels, ensuring consistent brand voice and quality.Website, Digital Visibility and AEO•    Maintain and develop the website and social media channels, identifying opportunities to improve user experience, engagement and agreed performance metrics.•    Lead the development and implementation of agreed search visibility initiatives, including search engine optimisation (SEO) and Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) across AI-powered search platforms.•    Monitor website and digital content analytics, AI search visibility, brand share of voice and competitor activity; identify improvements to digital discoverability.•    Produce and update digital creative assets and visuals for the website, social media and campaign communications.Media Relations and Strategic Partnerships•    Develop and maintain relationships with media and communications partners, where relevant, to support brand visibility and audience reach.•    Identify opportunities for editorial coverage, thought leadership, sponsored content and collaborative marketing initiatives.•    Prepare or coordinate press releases, media announcements and supporting promotional materials; liaise with internal stakeholders and external partners on delivery.Client Recognition and Relationship Support•    Support clients in activating their Great Place to Work® recognitions and employer-branding opportunities.•    Develop recognition toolkits, campaign materials and other communications resources suited to client needs.•    Maintain positive client relationships and coordinate agreed recognition benefits, promotional exposure and communications support.Marketing Operations, Events and Collaboration•    Create and manage HubSpot marketing workflows, calls to action, email campaigns and mailings; monitor and report on relevant metrics.•    Support the planning and delivery of company events, including required on-site marketing and promotional activity.•    Collaborate across marketing, client services and business development to ensure consistent communications and support business objectives.Core Competencies•    Strong copywriting, digital storytelling, editorial planning and brand communications skills.•    Working knowledge of social media, website content management, SEO/AEO, digital analytics and marketing automation tools.•    Ability to coordinate campaigns, manage several priorities and meet deadlines with a proactive, organised approach.•    Confident communication and stakeholder-management skills, with a client-focused and collaborative working style.•    Creative judgement, commercial awareness, curiosity and an interest in workplace culture and employee experience.•    Ability to use marketing data to assess performance, identify opportunities and recommend actions.•    Professional discretion, integrity and the ability to handle confidential information.Qualifications and Experience•    Minimum of 1–2 years’ professional experience in marketing, digital communications, content development or a related area.•    Relevant BA or BSc degree required; a relevant Master’s qualification is an advantage.•    Experience using HubSpot and working in a business-to-business (B2B) environment is an advantage.•    Excellent written and spoken English.Working RequirementsThe role involves regular computer-based, online and telephone work and occasional attendance at company events and client locations, as required. Work arrangements and reasonable accommodation will be managed in accordance with company policy and applicable legislation. Role is based in the Republic of Ireland.

description: La Divisione Permanent di Gi Group (Aut. La rete retail italiana rappresenta un punto di riferimento per clienti appassionati, esigenti e fortemente fidelizzati, che cercano un'esperienza di servizio all'altezza di un marchio iconico. Il contesto è altamente strutturato, orientato alla qualità, alla precisione tecnica e alla cura del cliente in ogni fase del ciclo di vita del veicolo. Missione del ruolo La risorsa si occuperà, in base al livello di autonomia e competenze maturate, di diagnosi, ricerca guasti, manutenzione, riparazione e collaudo dei veicoli, intervenendo su sistemi meccanici, elettrici ed elettronici, incluse le vetture elettrificate e BEV. Cosa farai Eseguirai attività di diagnosi strutturata e ricerca guasti, individuando la causa primaria delle anomalie e definendo gli interventi correttivi necessari. Effettuerai interventi di manutenzione ordinaria e straordinaria, riparazione e sostituzione componenti su tutta la gamma. Svolgerai verifiche e controlli su motore, trasmissione, freni, sterzo, sospensioni e sui principali sistemi elettrici/elettronici e ADAS. Utilizzerai strumenti diagnostici dedicati (es. tester di marca e relativi applicativi), interpretando correttamente DTC, parametri e informazioni tecniche. Applicherai manuali e procedure tecniche del costruttore e le regole di sicurezza previste per le lavorazioni. Opererai su veicoli elettrificati/BEV e, se in possesso delle qualifiche, su sistemi ad alta tensione, nel rispetto delle procedure di sicurezza. Eseguirai controlli, misurazioni, regolazioni, programmazioni e verifiche funzionali post-intervento (incluse prove su strada dove previste). Documenterai in modo accurato diagnosi e attività svolte, garantendo tracciabilità e fornendo indicazioni tecniche chiare all'Accettazione. Collaborerai con Magazzino Ricambi per identificazione e disponibilità componenti e supporterai, per quanto di competenza, la gestione pratiche garanzia. Lavorerai in sinergia con il team e parteciperai a programmi di formazione/aggiornamento per restare allineato all'evoluzione tecnologica (elettrificazione, elettronica, diagnostica, sistemi digitali). Requisiti Diploma tecnico (Meccanica/Meccatronica/Elettronica/Elettrotecnica o equivalente). Esperienza significativa nel settore automotive in ruoli di tecnico meccanico/meccatronico/diagnostico/officina. Solida conoscenza dei sistemi meccanici, elettrici ed elettronici del veicolo. Buona capacità di diagnosi e ricerca guasti con strumentazione. Conoscenza dei principi di funzionamento di tecnologie elettrificate e BEV (batterie, ricarica, alta tensione); qualifiche specifiche HV preferenziali. Buona familiarità con strumenti informatici e diagnostici automotive. Capacità di consultare e applicare documentazione e procedure tecniche. Patente B. Are you in?Your roleKey responsibilities in your new role- Act as the technical lead and methodological expert for Burn-in (BI), including steering BI decisions, driving continuous improvements, and serving as the primary interface to technology and product development as well as statistics teams- Provide teaching, coaching, and knowledge transfer on Burn-in topics to cross-functional teams, ensuring a consistent and high-quality understanding of BI methodologies across the organization- Support Design for Stress (DfS) sustaining activities, including the management and resolution of DfS Jira Tickets in close collaboration with relevant stakeholders- Serve as the 1st level of support for internal customer inquiries, with a particular focus on** Automotive Governance**, ensuring timely and solution-oriented responses- Drive long-term, strategically important tasks that require sustained attention, ensuring that critical but non-urgent topics receive appropriate prioritization and follow-through- Collaborate closely with Front-End (FE), Back-End (BE) and product development teams, contributing expert knowledge on failure mechanisms, defects, design and test conditions to support informed quality decisions- Lead customer communications about early topics- Contribute to the continuous improvement of Quality Management Systems (QMS), processes, methods, and tools along the entire supply chain, with a strong automotive quality mindsetYour profileQualifications and skills to help you succeed - A degree in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Materials Science, Physics, or a related field- At least 6 years of professional work experience in semiconductor manufacturing, with a strong focus on quality management along the supply chain, Front-End and Back-End processes, and reliability testing- Expert-level knowledge in Burn-in methodologies, including deep understanding of physical failure mechanisms, defect analysis, Fault Analysis (FA), and test conditions relevant to semiconductor devices- Proven experience as a technical lead in a cross-functional environment, with the ability to drive decisions, align stakeholders, and manage Design for Stress (DfS) activities effectively- Solid understanding of wafer manufacturing process, foundational skills in data analysis, and familiarity with chip design, test engineering and product development processes- Proficiency in digital collaboration tools such as Confluence, Jira, and Intranet platforms- Show a strong automotive quality mindset and knowledge about automotive requirements- Outstanding interpersonal skills and a genuine service provider attitude, with demonstrated ability to coach, teach, and inspire colleagues while fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture- Fluent English (written and spoken); German is a plusPlease send us your CV in EnglishPlease note that:- Subject to meeting all job requirements, belonging to protected categories under Law 68/69 will be considered a preferential requirementAdditional information by locationAustriaWe offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience, and qualification. The employment is in accordance with the collective salary and wage agreement for employees of the electrical and electronics industry, employment group H,I (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/ (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/) ). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p.a. We offer a higher compensation depending on your expertise and skills.Salary pay information:In line with local legal requirements, indicative salary ranges are disclosed for selected locations where applicable.LocationIndicative salary rangePadova, Italy*€52,000 – €71,500*The stated salary comprises annual base pay and target variable compensation. The starting salary is determined using objective, gender neutral criteria, including relevant experience, qualifications, and role scope; prior compensation is not requested or considered. Employees also benefit from a comprehensive total rewards package, which may include further compensation and benefit elements depending on local regulations and company policies.#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.Are you in?We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.Learn more about our various contact channels (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/about-infineon/company/contacts/)  and about Diversity & Inclusion (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/careers/diversity-and-inclusion/)  at Infineon.HRC1792713

title: Fahrer (m/w/divers) für Showtruck gesucht (Berufskraftfahrer/in)
description: .....gesucht wird ein "bewirtender" Berufskraftfahrer oder "kundenorientierter" Gastronom mit Lkw-Führerschein.....Wir suchen einen zuverlässigen und erfahrenen Lkw-Fahrer mit Führerschein C/CE für unseren Showtruck, der sich um die sichere und effiziente Beförderung unserer Gastronomie-Einrichtung kümmert und nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs ist, insbesondere in Italien und Frankreich.Als Lkw-Fahrer werden Sie für die Bedienung und Wartung des Fahrzeugs verantwortlich sein und sicherstellen, dass alle Aufgaben im Zusammenhang mit dem Auf- und Abbau der Gastronomie-Einrichtung reibungslos durchgeführt werden. Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören die Fahrt zu den Veranstaltungsorten, der Auf- und Abbau der Einrichtung, der Ausschank und die Betreuung der Gäste. Wir suchen einen Kandidaten mit ausgeprägten Fahrkenntnissen, excellenten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und einer tiefen Erfahrung im Umgang mit Lkw und Gastronomie-Einrichtungen.Die Stelle erfordert eine hohe Flexibilität und die Bereitschaft, nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs zu sein. Wenn Sie eine Herausforderung suchen und sich für eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit begeistern, dann sind Sie bei uns richtig.Zum Aufgabengebiet gehören voraussichtlich aber nicht ausschließlich:- Mitreisetätigkeit an 6-10 Monaten am Stück im Jahr, ausdehnbar auf 12 Monate im Jahr, wenn erste Teilsaison stimmt- Erfahrung im Betrieb/Mitreisen bei Schaustellerbetrieben, Eventbereich- leichter Auf- und Abbau von Gerätschaften während der Tour- Eventunterstützung von Organisation vor Ort- Terminplanung Tour- Ausschankbetrieb- Führerschein Klasse CEPersönliche Voraussetzungen:- Unabhängigkeit- Altersvorgabe 30-58- technisches Verständnis Light&Sound und LKW-Technik- englisch fließend, jede weitere Fremdsprache ist willkommen- Persönlichkeit: präsent, kommunikativ, selbstbewusstInteresse? Bitte teilen Sie uns mit, wenn Sie weitere Fragen haben oder wenn Sie sich für diese Stelle interessieren.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Getränke zubereiten und anrichten, Fahrzeugführung, Gästebetreuung, Technisches Verständnis

title: commerciante all’ingrosso
description: Grafton Office* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Accounting, Sales, Marketing, HR, Legal, Purchasing and Office Management. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Per importante azienda cliente ricerchiamo: Buying Planner La risorsa, inserita all'interno dell'Ufficio Buying e in collaborazione con i Buyer e la Direzione Commerciale, supporterà le attività di pianificazione, monitoraggio e gestione operativa degli ordini, contribuendo all'ottimizzazione della disponibilità del prodotto, della rotazione delle scorte e della marginalità. Nello specifico, la figura inserita si occuperà di: Monitorare le performance di vendita dei prodotti, analizzando sell-in, sell-out, stock, rotazioni, stock coverage e marginalità per categoria, brand, linea e punto vendita, individuando trend, criticità e opportunità commerciali; Supportare la pianificazione degli assortimenti e dei fabbisogni di prodotto per insegna, categoria, stagione e canale distributivo, sulla base dei dati storici, previsionali e degli obiettivi commerciali; Supportare il team Buying nella definizione dei quantitativi di acquisto e nella costruzione dell'assortimento; Monitorare il ciclo di vita del prodotto, dall'ingresso in assortimento fino alla fase di fine stagione, individuando eventuali criticità e opportunità di intervento; Analizzare le giacenze e individuare tempestivamente situazioni di overstock, understock e slow moving, supportando la definizione delle relative azioni correttive; Supportare il team Buying, in collaborazione con Planning & Allocation, nell'individuazione delle esigenze di riassortimento e redistribuzione del prodotto; Monitorare l'andamento dei budget di acquisto e degli obiettivi economici assegnati alle diverse categorie merceologiche, segnalando eventuali scostamenti; Gestire operativamente l'inserimento, l'emissione e l'aggiornamento degli ordini di acquisto a sistema, assicurando la correttezza delle informazioni relative a prodotti, quantità, prezzi e condizioni concordate; Monitorare l'avanzamento degli ordini, verificando conferme d'ordine, variazioni, cancellazioni ed eventuali anomalie e interfacciandosi con i fornitori per gli aspetti operativi; Presidiare il follow-up delle consegne e il rispetto delle tempistiche previste, segnalando tempestivamente eventuali ritardi o scostamenti rispetto alla pianificazione e garantendo l'allineamento tra piano di acquisto, ordini emessi e merce in consegna; Predisporre e mantenere aggiornata la reportistica relativa a ordini, budget impegnato, consegne, stock e performance di prodotto, fornendo analisi a supporto dell'Ufficio Buying e della Direzione Commerciale. Requisiti richiesti: Laurea in discipline economiche, statistiche, gestionali, moda o affini. Esperienza pregressa di almeno 2-3 anni in ruoli di Buying Planning, Merchandise Planning, Buying, Merchandising o Product Management, preferibilmente nel settore fashion retail. Conoscenza delle logiche di assortimento, pianificazione e gestione dello stock nel settore retail. Spiccata capacità di analisi e interpretazione dei dati. Utilizzo avanzato di Excel; gradita la conoscenza di strumenti di Business Intelligence. Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Completano il profilo: approccio analitico e commerciale, capacità di lettura delle performance di prodotto, ottime capacità organizzative e di pianificazione, precisione, problem solving, Sede di lavoro: Palermo, Orari: Lun-Ven 8:30 - 13:00 / 14:30 - 18:00 CCNL Commercio Range Retributivo previsto: € 23.300 - € 27.000. Il posizionamento all'interno della fascia sarà determinato sulla base delle competenze e dell'esperienza professionale coerenti con i requisiti della posizione. *Grafton Office è una specializzazione di Gi Group Spa autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut.Min. 26/11/2004 PROT. 1101 - SG). L'offerta si intende rivolta a candidati e candidate nel rispetto del D.lgs. n. 198/2006 e ss.mm.ii. e dei Decreti Legislativi n. 215 e n. 216 del 2003 sulle parità di trattamento. Invitiamo chi si candida a leggere l'informativa privacy ai sensi degli artt. 13 e 14 del Reg. EU 679/2016 al seguente indirizzo www.gigroup.it/privacy-candidati

title: commerciante all’ingrosso
description: Il nostro cliente è una realtà italiana solida e strutturata attiva nelle grandi opere/infrastrutture, con forte presidio su cantieri, impianti e mezzi , che ci ha incaricato di ricercare per la sede di Sondrio un/una SENIOR BUYER - Lavori/Servizi/Forniture | Grandi Opere/Infrastrutture (Sondrio) La risorsa riporterà al Responsabile Ufficio Acquisti e avrà il compito di assicurare l'attività di approvvigionamento di lavori, servizi e forniture in ambito grandi opere e infrastrutture pubbliche, in funzione delle esigenze produttive dei cantieri per la parte plant & equipment. Nello specifico, la risorsa: Gestisce l'albo fornitori: selezione, aggiornamento e proposta di approvazione in linea con procedure interne. Prepara e invia le richieste di offerta, raccoglie le proposte e coordina le verifiche tecniche con le funzioni richiedenti. segue la negoziazione economica e contrattuale (tempi, condizioni, SLA), con attenzione a qualità, lead time e ottimizzazione costi. Desideriamo entrare in contatto con Senior Buyers in possesso di laurea in Ingegneria (Civile, Gestionale, Edile, Meccanica, dei Processi) oppure Diploma di Geometra con esperienza negli acquisti legati ai cantieri, in particolare su impianti e macchinari, materiali, ricambi e servizi (es. manutenzioni) e provenienza da contesti strutturati (ad es società di infrastrutture/costruzioni, EPC contractors, Oil & Gas, aziende produttrici di mezzi di movimentazione/sollevamento). È richiesta la conoscenza della normativa sugli Appalti Pubblici, una buona padronanza del pacchetto Office (soprattutto Excel) e, preferibilmente, familiarità con sistemi ERP (SAP). Completano il profilo autonomia operativa, capacità di lavorare in team e orientamento al risultato. Sede di lavoro: Sondrio con smart working 8 gg/mese. È richiesta motivazione al trasferimento; è previsto un pacchetto di relocation (inclusa foresteria, contributo spese viaggio) Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. title: geologo/geologa
description: Grafton Engineering* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Progettazione, Logistica e Supply Chain, Production&Maintenance, Qualità - Sicurezza e Ambiente, Process & Project Management. Per Azienda internazionale, leader nella progettazione e costruzione di macchinari per la produzione industriale, Automazione, Robotica e Converting, selezioniamo: SOFTWARE ENGINEER - Automation & Robotics Di cosa ti occuperai? Inserito/a nel reparto Engineering, contribuirai allo sviluppo di soluzioni software avanzate per macchine e impianti automatici, integrando automazione, robotica e visione artificiale, con focus su performance, affidabilità e sicurezza. In particolare ti occuperai di: Analisi di richieste tecniche post-vendita (upgrade, miglioramenti, bug fixing) e supporto alla definizione della soluzione (fattibilità e impatti). Sviluppo & commissioning automazione: PLC, Motion, HMI/SCADA (Siemens/Rockwell/Beckhoff/Codesys). Test/validazione/ottimizzazione in collaborazione con i referenti tecnici di plant. Troubleshooting e analisi di anomalie con approccio strutturato (raccolta evidenze, riproducibilità, proposta di fix). Produzione/aggiornamento della documentazione tecnica (specifiche di base, note di rilascio, report test). Collaborazione con team cross-funzionali (meccanica, elettrica, automazione) per integrazione e miglioramento continuo Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? Laurea in Ingegneria (Automazione/Robotica/Informatica/Meccatronica/Elettrica-Elettronica o affini); gradita magistrale/specializzazione AI-Vision. 2-5 anni di esperienza in sviluppo software per automazione industriale, macchine/impianti, o sistemi complessi in contesti industriali. Programmazione: C++ e/o C# e/o Python; graditi OOP, UML, Design Patterns, DBMS. Familiarità con contesti di automazione industriale e integrazione software-hardware; gradita conoscenza di protocolli/fieldbus e ambienti Linux. description: Grafton Engineering is a team dedicated to enhancing the experience, skills and potential of candidates in Design, Logistics & Supply Chain, Production&Maintenance, Quality - Safety & Environment, Process & Project Management. Saipem Spa is a global leader in engineering and construction for the energy and infrastructure sectors, delivering complex onshore and offshore projects worldwide. Driven by technological innovation as 'One Company', our 30,000 people from over 130 nationalities in more than 50 countries work every day to enable the energy transition toward Net Zero. At Saipem, we embrace diversity as a driver of innovation and inclusion, while prioritizing people's safety and environmental sustainability, even in the most challenging conditions. As Maintenance Engineering Specialist you will respond to the Maintenance Engineering Lead and be part of the Energy Carriers Business Line within EPC Maintenance and Inspection Engineering Department. Job includes plant reliability analysis, equipment criticality assessment and maintenance plan development. Scope of the work involves activities ranging from acknowledging of process-related conditions and evaluating the equipment detail design. Maintenance Engineering Specialist (MES) is to make sure that the project detailed design is safe and sound from an operation and maintenance point of view, complies with the international standards and meet the requirements arising from contract and technical specification therein referred to. In performing his job, the MES is liaising with client representatives, partners, suppliers and project team. MES regularly reports to the Commissioning, Operation and Maintenance manager the status of the Maintenance Engineering assessment, highlighting areas of concern. title: Manufacturing, mining, construction, and distribution managers
description: La Divisione Permanent di Gi Group (Aut. Min. 26/11/04 Prot. n. 1101-SG), con un team di consulenti specializzati, supporta da anni le aziende nella ricerca e selezione di professionisti qualificati, motivati e desiderosi di crescere in contesti tecnici e strutturati. Per prestigioso Cliente, stiamo ricercando UN* TECNICO DI OFFICINA - DIAGNOSTICO Centro Automotive Premium - Milano Settore: Centro Automotive Premium - Milano Est L'azienda è un player storico del settore automotive premium, riconosciuto a livello internazionale per il design distintivo, le prestazioni sportive e l'eccellenza ingegneristica. La rete retail italiana rappresenta un punto di riferimento per clienti appassionati, esigenti e fortemente fidelizzati, che cercano un'esperienza di servizio all'altezza di un marchio iconico. Il contesto è altamente strutturato, orientato alla qualità, alla precisione tecnica e alla cura del cliente in ogni fase del ciclo di vita del veicolo. Missione del ruolo La risorsa si occuperà, in base al livello di autonomia e competenze maturate, di diagnosi, ricerca guasti, manutenzione, riparazione e collaudo dei veicoli, intervenendo su sistemi meccanici, elettrici ed elettronici, incluse le vetture elettrificate e BEV. Cosa farai Eseguirai attività di diagnosi strutturata e ricerca guasti, individuando la causa primaria delle anomalie e definendo gli interventi correttivi necessari. Effettuerai interventi di manutenzione ordinaria e straordinaria, riparazione e sostituzione componenti su tutta la gamma. Svolgerai verifiche e controlli su motore, trasmissione, freni, sterzo, sospensioni e sui principali sistemi elettrici/elettronici e ADAS. Utilizzerai strumenti diagnostici dedicati (es. tester di marca e relativi applicativi), interpretando correttamente DTC, parametri e informazioni tecniche. Applicherai manuali e procedure tecniche del costruttore e le regole di sicurezza previste per le lavorazioni. Opererai su veicoli elettrificati/BEV e, se in possesso delle qualifiche, su sistemi ad alta tensione, nel rispetto delle procedure di sicurezza. Eseguirai controlli, misurazioni, regolazioni, programmazioni e verifiche funzionali post-intervento (incluse prove su strada dove previste). Documenterai in modo accurato diagnosi e attività svolte, garantendo tracciabilità e fornendo indicazioni tecniche chiare all'Accettazione. Collaborerai con Magazzino Ricambi per identificazione e disponibilità componenti e supporterai, per quanto di competenza, la gestione pratiche garanzia. Lavorerai in sinergia con il team e parteciperai a programmi di formazione/aggiornamento per restare allineato all'evoluzione tecnologica (elettrificazione, elettronica, diagnostica, sistemi digitali). Requisiti Diploma tecnico (Meccanica/Meccatronica/Elettronica/Elettrotecnica o equivalente). Esperienza significativa nel settore automotive in ruoli di tecnico meccanico/meccatronico/diagnostico/officina. Solida conoscenza dei sistemi meccanici, elettrici ed elettronici del veicolo. Buona capacità di diagnosi e ricerca guasti con strumentazione. Conoscenza dei principi di funzionamento di tecnologie elettrificate e BEV (batterie, ricarica, alta tensione); qualifiche specifiche HV preferenziali. Buona familiarità con strumenti informatici e diagnostici automotive. Capacità di consultare e applicare documentazione e procedure tecniche. Patente B. Competenze trasversali: -Orientamento alla qualità e alla precisione - affidabilità e responsabilità - curiosità tecnica e approccio analitico -proattività e problem solving -capacità di lavorare sotto pressione mantenendo standard elevati - collaborazione con officina/accettazione/ricambi e comunicazione chiara verso interlocutori interni - attenzione alla sicurezza e all'impatto sul Cliente. Orario di lavoro: full- time Sede di lavoro: Milano Est #LI-GM12 Facciamo parte di Gi Group Holding (www.gigroupholding.it), la prima multinazionale italiana del lavoro, attiva in oltre 37 Paesi con più di 9.000 persone. Operiamo in Temporary, Permanent e Professional Staffing, Executive Search, Outsourcing, Formazione, Consulenza HR e Transizione di Carriera. I nostri valori: attenzione, collaborazione, passione, sostenibilità, apprendimento continuo, innovazione e responsabilità. title: ingegnere esperto in sottostazioni elettriche
description: Grafton Engineering* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Progettazione, Logistica e Supply Chain, Production&Maintenance, Qualità - Sicurezza e Ambiente, Process & Project Management. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati: lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni e i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Per importante realtà storica e riconosciuta a livello internazionale, leader nella progettazione, produzione e installazione di sistemi automatici per l'imbottigliamento, parte di un solido gruppo industriale, ricerchiamo un/a: PROJECT MANAGER - LEADER INTERNAZIONALE SISTEMI AUTOMATICI PER L'IMBOTTIGLIAMENTO La risorsa sarà inserita nel team Project Management e avrà la responsabilità di gestire progetti su commessa legati alla realizzazione di macchine e linee per l'imbottigliamento, contribuendo al rispetto di tempi, costi e qualità, in un contesto strutturato e ad alto contenuto tecnico. Di cosa ti occuperai? - Coordinare i kick-off meeting e l'intero ciclo di vita del progetto, dall'avvio alla consegna - Monitorare tempi, costi, qualità e rischi, garantendo l'allineamento tra piano e avanzamento - Applicare metodologie di project management e standard aziendali, assicurando coerenza e tracciabilità - Gestione della reportistica e aggiornamento puntuale degli stakeholder sull'avanzamento - Facilitare la comunicazione tra stakeholder interni ed esterni (produzione, ufficio tecnico, qualità, cliente/fornitori) - Gestire FAT e milestone di progetto, supportando la corretta esecuzione delle attività e delle validazioni - Supportare iniziative di miglioramento continuo su processi e strumenti di gestione commessa Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? - Laurea ad indirizzo tecnico-ingegneristico - Esperienza di almeno 3 anni maturata in realtà strutturate in ambito di project management - Solida esperienza nella gestione di progetti su commessa: stima e controllo dei costi, pianificazione delle risorse, gestione dei rischi, monitoraggio di specifiche tecniche di progetto, controllo timelines, gestione della documentazione del progetto - Solida esperienza con strumenti e processi di project management - Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese Offerta Contrattuale: - Contratto: Inserimento diretto in azienda con contratto a tempo indeterminato - CCNL applicato: Metalmeccanico - Retribuzione prevista: compresa tra € 35.000 e € 45.000 lordi annui, definita in base all'inquadramento contrattuale, alle mansioni previste e alle caratteristiche della posizione Orario di lavoro: Full time, dal lunedì al venerdì Luogo di lavoro: Zimella (VR) Se pensi di avere le competenze e l'attitudine per questo ruolo, inviaci la tua candidatura! *Grafton Engineering è una specializzazione di Gi Group Spa autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. description: Grafton Banking&Insurance* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito bancario, finanziario ed assicurativo. title: tecnico informatico
description: Cerchi un'opportunità in cui applicare le tue competenze tecniche? Gi Pro Mechanics 4.0 è la specializzazione di Gi Group dedicata a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito meccanico, meccatronico ed elettromeccanico. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Per strutturata azienda cliente del settore metalmeccanico stiamo ricercando OPERAIO ADDETTO ALLA FORGIA Di cosa ti occuperai? Dopo un primo periodo di affiancamento, la risorsa di occuperà principalmente delle seguenti attività: - Spostamento di lingotti pesanti tra forni e presse - Rotazione e posizionamento continuo del pezzo ad altissime temperature sotto la pressa seguendo le direttive del capo-forgiatore - Monitoraggio costante del processo Hai le seguenti caratteristiche? Precisione, serietà e voglia di mettersi in gioco Buona manualità e capacità di utilizzo strumenti di misura e da banco Gradita conoscenza di disegno meccanico Gradita esperienza nella mansione Ti riconosci in queste caratteristiche?
