You will play a central role in developing and shaping our orthopaedic service, with access to a state-of-the-art surgical environment featuring four spacious operating theatres, two of which are dedicated to orthopaedics. Our equipment includes CT, an arthroscopy tower and a C-arm fluoroscopy system - providing excellent conditions for advanced diagnostics and surgical procedures. You will become part of an experienced and dedicated team of veterinary nurses, veterinary surgeons and veterinary care assistants, all accustomed to working with advanced surgical cases. Together, you will manage everything from orthopaedic investigations to complex surgical procedures, treating both referral patients and emergency cases. You will also work closely with colleagues in anaesthesia, neurology, diagnostic imaging and rehabilitation. About the Role As an Orthopaedic Veterinary Surgeon, you will play an important role in establishing and developing our service. You will have considerable scope to influence both clinical practice and the future direction of our orthopaedic offering. Your responsibilities will include: Performing advanced orthopaedic investigations and surgical procedures. Carrying out procedures such as TPLO, fracture repair, arthroscopy, patellar surgery and other orthopaedic interventions. Managing both referral patients and emergency orthopaedic cases. Working closely with our teams in surgery, neurology, anaesthesia, diagnostic imaging and rehabilitation. Contributing to the development of clinical practices, protocols and future treatment opportunities. Sharing your expertise, mentoring colleagues and fostering a strong culture of knowledge exchange. This is more than the next step in your veterinary career. It is an opportunity to build something from the ground up, influence its direction and leave your mark on an entirely new orthopaedic service. We are building the animal hospital of the future in Kalmar. Would you like to help write its first chapter? About AniCura Sweden Since 2018, AniCura Sweden has been part of Mars Veterinary Health, a global network that creates excellent opportunities for knowledge sharing, innovation and professional development. With more than 450 clinics and animal hospitals across Europe, AniCura is one of the leading providers of advanced veterinary care. In Sweden, we are one of the largest veterinary care providers, with hospitals and clinics across the country and a strong local presence. Our dedicated teams work together to provide the best possible care for every patient, every day. Through a culture built on collaboration, continuous learning and medical excellence, we offer opportunities to grow, make an impact and truly make a difference. We are covered by collective bargaining agreements and offer secure employment conditions, including occupational pension, insurance and a wellness allowance, as well as excellent opportunities for continuous professional development throughout your career. Salary and benefits We offer competitive compensation packages based on your experience, competencies and role. Salary and benefits are discussed individually and transparently during the recruitment process. Interested? We warmly welcome your application! Applications and interviews are reviewed on an ongoing basis. The starting date is negotiable. Please note that the position may be filled before the application deadline of 31 December 2026. We value diversity and welcome applicants with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives - we believe this contributes to greater quality and innovation in everything we do. Please attach a copy of your veterinary licence issued by the Swedish Board of Agriculture (Jordbruksverket) when submitting your application. For questions about the recruitment process or the position, please feel free to contact: Talent Acquisition Partner Emma Idman talent@anicura.se

title: Head of Engineering & Operations / CTO
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Head of Engineering &amp; Operations / CTO--- Head of Engineering \& Operations / CTO=======================================**Über cyon**Seit 2003 helfen wir Menschen, ihre Ideen ins Internet zu bringen, heute für rund 50'000 Kundinnen und Kunden. Wir sind ein inhabergeführtes Unternehmen mit rund 50 Mitarbeitenden und betreiben unsere Plattform in Basel mit 100 % erneuerbarer Energie.Wir stehen für persönlichen Support, einfache Produkte und digitale Selbstbestimmung. Unsere Kundinnen und Kunden sollen ihren digitalen Raum unabhängig von grossen Plattformen gestalten können. Ihre Daten bleiben in der Schweiz.Wir entwickeln cyon vom erfolgreichen Hosting\-Anbieter zu einer Plattform, auf der Menschen und KI\-Agenten digitale Projekte einfach, sicher und selbstbestimmt umsetzen können. Dafür suchen wir eine technische Führungspersönlichkeit, die unseren zuverlässigen Betrieb sichert und gleichzeitig die technologische Zukunft von cyon gestaltet.  **Deine Aufgaben*** **Führung** Du führst und entwickelst unsere Mitarbeitenden in Engineering \& Operations. Du stärkst Eigenverantwortung, entwickelst Führungspersönlichkeiten und schaffst Strukturen, in denen Teams wirksam zusammenarbeiten und gute Entscheidungen treffen können.* **Strategie und Prioritäten** Als Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung trägst du Verantwortung für cyon als Ganzes. Du verantwortest Budget, Personalplanung und Ressourcenallokation deines Bereichs und übersetzt Produktziele gemeinsam mit Business Development in eine verbindliche technische Roadmap.* **Architektur und Betrieb** Gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Engineers entwickelst du die Zielarchitektur unserer Software und Infrastruktur weiter und sorgst dafür, dass Entscheide getroffen und umgesetzt werden. Mit deinen Teams gewährleistest du einen sicheren Betrieb rund um die . Dazu gehören Monitoring, Pikett, Incident Management, Backup und Disaster Recovery. Gleichzeitig modernisierst du gezielt unsere bestehenden Systeme.* «**AI first, human accountable»** Du machst KI\-gestützte und agentische Arbeitsweisen zum selbstverständlichen Bestandteil unserer Engineering\-Organisation. Du erkennst, wo KI echten Mehrwert schafft, förderst den gezielten Einsatz und stellst Qualität, Sicherheit und menschliche Verantwortung sicher.* **Sicherheit und Datenschutz** Du verantwortest die technische Informationssicherheit, den Schutz unserer Infrastruktur und die Umsetzung technischer Datenschutzanforderungen. Du entwickelst Sicherheitsstandards und Risikomanagement gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsleitung weiter.**Das bringst du mit*** **Führungserfahrung** Du hast technische Organisationen geleitet und Führungskräfte entwickelt. Dein Führungsstil verbindet Vertrauen und Freiraum mit klaren Erwartungen und Verbindlichkeit. Schwierige Themen sprichst du offen und respektvoll an.* **Technische Tiefe** Du hast selbst Software entwickelt und Architekturen entworfen und bist auch in der Infrastruktur (Linux, Virtualisierung, Netzwerk, Storage) und in DevOps\-Praktiken (CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code) zuhause. Du musst nicht in jedem Fachgebiet am tiefsten drin sein, kannst aber technische Vorschläge im Detail beurteilen und fundiert entscheiden.* **KI in der Praxis** KI\-Werkzeuge und agentische Arbeitsweisen sind für dich bereits Arbeitsrealität. Du kannst an konkreten Beispielen zeigen, wie du damit Arbeit verbessert hast, und weisst, wo menschliche Kontrolle für Qualität, Sicherheit und Datenschutz unverzichtbar bleibt.* **Erfahrung mit Veränderung** Du hast gewachsene Systeme im laufenden Betrieb modernisiert, ohne das Tagesgeschäft zu gefährden. Du setzt klare Prioritäten, entscheidest auch bei unvollständiger Information und wägst Kundennutzen, technische Qualität, Aufwand und Risiko gegeneinander ab.* **Weitere Grundlagen** Du hast ein solides Verständnis von IT\-Sicherheit und Erfahrung mit verteilten Teams. Du kommunizierst sehr gut auf Deutsch und gut auf Englisch. Erfahrung im Hosting\- oder Cloud\-Umfeld oder mit PHP\-Plattformen ist ein Plus.**Was wir Dir bieten*** **Unternehmerischer Gestaltungsspielraum** Du bist Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung und gestaltest die technologische und strategische Zukunft eines unabhängigen Schweizer Unternehmens mit.* **Klare Entscheidungskompetenzen** Du entscheidest innerhalb deines Budgets über Technologie, Architektur, Standards und Beschaffung. Kurze Entscheidungswege ermöglichen dir, Dinge tatsächlich zu verändern.* **Flexibilität und Erholung** Flexible Jahresarbeitszeit, 25 Ferientage, ab dem 5\. Dienstjahr 27 und ab dem 10\. Dienstjahr 30 Tage sowie Homeoffice und Workations im Rahmen unserer Remote\-Regelung.* **Arbeitsumfeld und Entwicklung** Ein modernes Büro in Basel, individuelle Arbeitsplatzausstattung und ein Team, das Technologie mit Leidenschaft und Verantwortung entwickelt, sowie Zeit und Budget für deine Weiterentwicklung.**Melde Dich**Neugierig geworden? Dann bewirb dich mit deinem CV und deinen relevanten Zeugnissen. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.  ![cyon AG]()* cyon AG  Hirschgässlein 30  4051 Basel*jid65ec716jm jit1146jm jiy26jm

Ces compétences répondent aux exigences de nos clients aussi bien au niveau technique qu’esthétique.Afin de renforcer notre Département **« Maintenance** **»**, nous recherchons un :Electricien de Maintenance (H/F)================================ **Missions :*** Réaliser les travaux de maintenance préventive, corrective et curative des machines conventionnelles, automatisées et à commande numérique pour les secteurs saphir et plasturgie ;  * Assurer la disponibilité, la fiabilité et la sécurité électrique des équipements de production ;  * Contribuer à l’amélioration des équipements afin de garantir la continuité de production et la qualité des produits, en collaboration avec les équipes techniques et de production.    **Responsabilités :*** Diagnostiquer les pannes électriques et les dysfonctionnements des systèmes de commande afin de rétablir la production ;  * Construction et/ou modification électriques des installations de production  * Appliquer les procédures de consignation et les règles de sécurité dans les limites de ses compétences et autorisations ;  * Contrôler le fonctionnement des équipements et des dispositifs de sécurité avant leur remise à disposition de la production ;  * Analyser les pannes récurrentes et mettre en œuvre des actions visant à fiabiliser les équipements ;  * Participer aux déménagements des machines et à l’installation, la mise en service et la modernisation des moyens de production ;  * Organiser ses interventions avec la production et les autres intervenants de maintenance selon les priorités définies ;  * Documenter les interventions et mettre à jour les schémas électriques et les dossiers techniques ;  * Identifier les besoins en pièces de rechange et contribuer à la disponibilité des composants critiques  * Accompagner les prestataires externes et transmettre aux équipes les bonnes pratiques d’utilisation et de surveillance des équipements ;  * Veiller à la sécurité des personnes, au respect des consignes et au maintien en bon état des équipements.   **Profil :** * CFC d’automaticien, d’électricien ou formation équivalente, avec au moins 5 ans d’expérience en maintenance de machines de production industrielle ;  * Maîtrise du diagnostic électrique, des appareils de mesure et de la lecture des schémas électriques ;  * Compétences en diagnostic sur automates et interfaces opérateur, avec des connaissances de base des commandes numériques et automates Fanuc, Siemens et Beckhoff ;  * Bonne compréhension des systèmes de chauffe et de régulation de température, ainsi que des interactions électriques, mécaniques, pneumatiques et hydrauliques ;  * Aisance avec les outils informatiques de maintenance et la documentation technique ; connaissances de base en anglais ;  * Des connaissances en robotique ( , Universal Robots) et en vision industrielle (Cognex) constituent des atouts ;  * Rigueur et sens des responsabilités en matière de sécurité ;  * Esprit d’analyse et approche méthodique de la résolution de problèmes ;  * Autonomie et fiabilité dans l’exécution des interventions ;  * Capacité à collaborer avec les équipes de production et de maintenance ;  * Sens de l’organisation et capacité à gérer les priorités ;  * Réactivité et maîtrise de soi face aux arrêts de production ;  * Esprit d’initiative, bonne communication et orientation vers des solutions durables.   **Horaires de travail :** Service de piquet et 2x8 possible **Nous offrons :*** Vacances : 5 semaines par année \+ 1 semaine sur rattrapage ;  * Pause de 15min offerte ;  * Salaire versé sur 13 mois ;  * Participation au paiement de votre caisse maladie ;  * Evénements réguliers (repas d'été, brunchs mensuels, sorties d'entreprise, etc.) ;  * Rabais chez différents partenaires (rabais flotte, ventes privées chez des marques prestigieuses, etc.) ;  * Environnement de travail sain, valorisant, dynamique et en constante évolution.   ![R. description: Ref 2590055 \| Date: 9 Nov 2026Chef de Partiealt\="" src\=" Logotype One Line "\>**Chef de Partie****Permanent contract** / Crans\-Montana, SwitzerlandLes Roches, part of Sommet Education group, is a globally renowned institution shaping the future of hospitality and the experience economy through transformative and experiential education in 3 campuses: Crans\-Montana (Switzerland), Marbella (Spain) and Abu Dhabi (UAE).2nd in the 2026 QS World University Ranking in Hospitality and Leisure Management and 2nd in employer reputation category.Accredited by the New England Commission of Higher Education (NECHE) and Swiss Accreditation Council (SAC) as a University of Applied Sciences Institute.Les Roches Marbella, certified ISO\-14001 and ISO\-9001\.Our values, *Development, Distinctiveness, Joint Commitment, Openness and Sense of Service*, are the foundation of our actions. We offer an innovative, collaborative and thriving environment.**Mission**  The Chef de Partie is responsible for the preparation, production, and presentation of food within an assigned kitchen section. Working under the supervision of the Executive Sous\-Chef and Kitchen Sous\-Chef, the role ensures the consistent application of culinary standards, food safety requirements, and operational procedures.  As part of Les Roches' experiential learning environment, the Chef de Partie supports students during practical sessions by demonstrating professional culinary techniques and fostering a culture of excellence, professionalism, and hospitality.**Main Responsibilities  1\. Execute Food Production Activities**  \- Prepare, cook, and present dishes according to established recipes, production plans, and quality standards.  \- Ensure consistency in food quality, presentation, and portion control.  \- Contribute to the smooth operation of daily kitchen activities within the assigned section.  **2\. Support Student Practical Training**  \- Assist students during practical kitchen sessions and operational service periods.  \- Demonstrate culinary techniques, kitchen organization, and professional work methods.  \- Promote discipline, teamwork, and compliance with operational standards.  **3\. Ensure Hygiene and Food Safety Compliance**  \- Maintain full compliance with HACCP standards, food safety regulations, and internal procedures.  \- Ensure cleanliness and organization of workstations, equipment, and storage areas.  \- Report any food safety or operational concerns to supervisors.  **4\. Maintain Kitchen Organization and Resources**  \- Assist with the proper storage, rotation, and handling of food products.  \- Support inventory counts and the monitoring of stock levels.  \- Contribute to reducing food waste and ensuring responsible use of resources.  **5\. Contribute to Operational Excellence**  \- Collaborate effectively with kitchen colleagues, instructors, and service teams.  \- Support special events, functions, and academic activities as required.  \- Actively contribute to maintaining a professional, positive, and guest\-focused kitchen environment.**Key Competencies**  Strong culinary fundamentals and technical cooking skills.  Good understanding of food safety and HACCP requirements.  Ability to work efficiently in a fast\-paced environment.  Strong attention to detail and quality standards.  Team\-oriented mindset and collaborative approach.  Ability to support and guide students through example.  Flexibility and adaptability in a multicultural environment.**Key Indicators**  Compliance with food safety and hygiene standards.  Quality and consistency of food production.  Preparedness and organization of assigned kitchen section.  Student and instructor satisfaction during practical activities.  Contribution to waste reduction and proper stock management.  Reliability and teamwork within kitchen operations.![]( )jpid629dc80jm jpit1146jm jpiy26jm

title: Curator
description: About HELVETIKA 1575HELVETIKA 1575 AG is a contemporary art gallery based in Zug, with a new gallery space opening on Rennweg in Zurich. We represent a deliberately small and selective group of international artists – from established names to mid\-career and emerging positions – and work closely with collectors, foundations and museums.We are looking for a Curator who will shape our exhibition programme and strengthen the gallery's institutional profile.The role**Position:** Curator  **Location:** Zurich, Switzerland  **Workload:** 100%  **Start date:** by arrangement  **Reports to:** Management (Stephan Jöbstl, Katerina Maliakina)You are responsible for the artistic programme of the gallery: exhibitions, artist development and institutional relationships. You work hands\-on in a small team and turn ideas into finished exhibitions, publications and placements.Key responsibilities* Develop and realise the annual exhibition programme in Zurich, including solo shows, group exhibitions and art fair presentations* Build and maintain close working relationships with our artists, including studio visits, production of new works and exhibition planning* Scout new artists and prepare well\-founded proposals for onboarding (established, mid\-career and emerging)* Develop institutional placements and partnerships with museums, foundations, biennials and curators* Write and edit exhibition texts, artist biographies, CVs, press releases and catalogue content* Coordinate exhibition logistics: loans, transport, insurance, installation and condition reports, together with the team* Represent the gallery at openings, art fairs and professional events, and contribute to collector and press relations* Plan your work in clear blocks with measurable goals and report progress in the weekly team meetingQualifications* A completed university degree in Art History, Curatorial Studies, Fine Arts, Cultural Management or a related field – or equivalent professional experience* At least 3 years of curatorial experience in a gallery, museum, foundation or art institution* A track record of exhibitions you have curated or co\-curated* A solid network among artists, curators and institutions, ideally in Switzerland and the DACH region* Excellent writing skills in English; German is a strong advantage, French a plus* Strong organisational skills, reliability and the ability to work independently and proactively in a small team* Confident, professional presence with artists, collectors and institutional partners* Willingness to travel (art fairs, studio visits, international exhibitions)What we offer* Real creative responsibility for the programme of a growing gallery with a new space in Zurich* Direct collaboration with the founders and short decision paths* Work with internationally recognised artists and institutional partners* A competitive salary based on experienceHow to applyPlease apply online with your CV, a short cover letter and a selection of exhibitions or projects you have curated. We look forward to hearing from you.j4id10475537jm j4it1146jm j4iy26jm

Gelegen auf dem Bürgenberg, einem 500 Meter hohen Felsvorsprung in der Zentralschweiz, zeichnet sich das Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne durch gewagtes Design, bahnbrechende Nachhaltigkeit, atemberaubende Landschaften und modernste Freizeitangebote aus. Rund 700 Mitarbeitende aus 54 Nationen sorgen für exzellente Gastfreundschaft und bieten den perfekten Rahmen für Momente jenseits der Vorstellungskraft.    Drei exklusive Hotels, das Bürgenstock Hotel \& Alpine Spa (5\* Superior) mit den beiden Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten The Contemporary und The Heritage, das Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5\* Superior) und die Taverne 1879 (3\*) stehen den Gästen zur Verfügung. Jedes dieser Häuser versteht es, eine einzigartige Atmosphäre zu kreieren. Sie verfügen über einen Ausbildung an einer Massageschule oder vergleichbare Zertifikate. Um unsere anspruchsvolle Kundschaft verwöhnen zu können, sollten Sie geübt sein mehrere Wellness\-Massagen am Tag durchzuführen. Mit ihrer herzlichen und aufgestellten , fällt es Ihnen leicht, sich auf Deutsch und Englisch zu unterhalten.    Neben einem modernen Arbeitsplatz profitieren Sie von zahlreichen attraktiven Mitarbeiterangeboten und Vergünstigungen. Darüber hinaus geniessen Sie Ermässigungen in unseren Restaurants sowie Vorzugskonditionen für Sie, Ihre Familie und Freunde für Übernachtungen in unseren Hotels. Weitere Vorteile umfassen Vergünstigungen für Tennis, Golf, Sportartikel, Versicherungen, Gruppenkurse und REKA\-Checks.    Auch Ihre Mobilität unterstützen wir: Die Anreise mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln wird finanziell gefördert, und Parkplätze stehen zu attraktiven Konditionen zur Verfügung.    Wir investieren in Ihre Zukunft: Mit Zugang zur Beekeeper\-Mitarbeiterapp, vielfältigen Weiterbildungsangeboten, internen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und erstklassigen Karriereperspektiven schaffen wir den Rahmen für Ihre persönliche und berufliche Entfaltung.    Sie erwartet die Chance, Teil eines Weltklasse\-Resorts zu sein, aktiv zum gemeinsamen Erfolg beizutragen und sich in einem inspirierenden Umfeld kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.    Wir freuen uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Motivationsschreiben, Arbeitszeugnissen und Foto.     *Auszeichnungen:*   *Swiss Location Awards **«Switzerland's best meeting Location»***   *World Spa Awards **«Switzerland's Best Hotel Spa 2025»***   *LHW Membership Awards **«Sustainability Leader»***   *Great Place To Work 2025*   *The New York Times' **«52 Places to Go in 2018»***   *Travel \+ Leisure **«500 List 2021»***   *Handelszeitung **«Bester Arbeitgeber im Hospitality Sektor 2023»** Connoisseur Circle **«Best Gourmet Hotel»**  MICHELIN Wellness Award **«Best Wellness Hotel»**  GALA Spa Awards **«Best Spa Concept»**  MICHELIN Keys **«3/3 Keys»***    BÜRGENSTOCK HOTELS AG  Koch  HR Assistant  Bürgenstock 30  6363 Obbürgen  Telefon      ******jidd636bd5jm jit1146jm jiy26jm

description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Field Application Engineer---Field Application Engineer==========================  **Are you ready to shape a brighter future?** Did you know that every second, an aircraft takes off somewhere in the world, and that 90% of them are equipped with a component produced in Fribourg? We are Hannifin, a global leader in motion and control technologies, with more than 58,000 team members across 44 countries. Our Business Unit in Fribourg, Switzerland, part of the Motion, Power, and Sensing division, is a technological and manufacturing center of excellence specializing in the development and production of measurement, control, and protection solutions for the aerospace and energy sectors. With around 400 employees, we design, qualify, and manufacture high\-performance sensors, electronic systems, and software monitoring solutions for critical and extreme environments. We are proud to work with passion, to enable engineering breakthrough and innovation. Joining Fribourg means contributing to high\-value international technology projects, growing in a collaborative and innovative environment, and developing your full professional and personal potential.  **Your responsibilities***       Perform on\-site installation, wiring verification, configuration, functional testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of vibration monitoring systems, sensors, protection racks, and related software; resolve hardware, software, and industrial networking issues at customer sites.  *       Coordinate with customer site personnel to confirm requirements and site readiness, apply applicable safety standards and site rules, and prepare field service reports, troubleshooting summaries, and root\-cause analysis logs.  *       Translate rotating machinery and condition monitoring requirements into technical proposals, system architectures, feasibility studies, system sizing, and technical solutions using proprietary sensor and monitoring product lines.  *       Coordinate technical input between customers, sales teams, distributors, OEMs, and local R\&D/Product Management teams in Fribourg; deliver technical presentations and solution explanations.  *       Support sales teams, distributors, and OEMs during customer discussions, new projects, and retrofit or modernization opportunities, including management of technical inquiries through the Customer Service Desk or Salesforce in line with defined KPIs.  *       Support project engineering teams during project execution, technical clarifications, Pre\-FAT, and FAT activities, ensuring customer requirements are understood and implemented.  *       Deliver advanced technical training and prepare customer\-facing and internal documentation, including commissioning records, intervention reports, and technical summaries.  *       Support investigation, testing, validation, and internal simulation activities related to customer issues, product behavior, and application performance; provide structured field feedback to R\&D/Product Management.    **Who we are looking for***       Degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Microengineering, Automation, Systems, Mechatronics, or equivalent.  *       Minimum 5 years of experience in application engineering, field service, commissioning, troubleshooting, and customer support within an industrial environment.  *       Experience in the energy sector or other industrial environments is an asset (Aerospace, heavy machinery or equivalent).  *       Strong technical knowledge of vibration monitoring, condition monitoring, rotating machinery, sensors, protection racks, and related software. understanding of signal processing, vibration analysis, electronics, and industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, Profibus, Profinet, and OPC. Vibration Analyst Category 2 certification is considered a strong asset  *       Excellent communication and interpersonal skills  *       Strong customer\-focused approach, curious and hands\-on  *       Professional fluency in English; French and/or considered as a strong asset  *       Willingness to travel up to 30% of the time    **What we offer***       Solid employer on the market for over 100 years, we manage the full product lifecycle and support leading aerospace and energy companies worldwide  *       Career growth, opportunities and training: we hire from within!  *       Collaborative and empowered work environment where team spirit is at the center of our success.  *       Company values that encourage trust, respect, collaboration and professional growth.  *       Open environment: we are excited to hear your ideas!  *       Attractive compensation packages designed to hire and retain the best talents in the industry.  *       Company restaurant and other benefits    If you don’t find yourself in all points, apply anyways, because all competencies are valued! title: Field Application Engineer
description: Ref 2590034 \| Date: 9 Nov 2026![MEGGITT SA]( )**Field Application Engineer****Are you ready to shape a brighter future?**Did you know that every second, an aircraft takes off somewhere in the world, and that 90% of them are equipped with a component produced in Fribourg? We are Parker Hannifin, a global leader in motion and control technologies, with more than 58,000 team members across 44 countries. Our Parker Business Unit in Fribourg, Switzerland, part of the Motion, Power, and Sensing division, is a technological and manufacturing center of excellence specializing in the development and production of measurement, control, and protection solutions for the aerospace and energy sectors. With around 400 employees, we design, qualify, and manufacture high\-performance sensors, electronic systems, and software monitoring solutions for critical and extreme environments. We are proud to work with passion, to enable engineering breakthrough and innovation. Joining Parker Fribourg means contributing to high\-value international technology projects, growing in a collaborative and innovative environment, and developing your full professional and personal potential.**Your responsibilities***      Perform on\-site installation, wiring verification, configuration, functional testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of vibration monitoring systems, sensors, protection racks, and related software; resolve hardware, software, and industrial networking issues at customer sites.*      Coordinate with customer site personnel to confirm requirements and site readiness, apply applicable safety standards and site rules, and prepare field service reports, troubleshooting summaries, and root\-cause analysis logs.*      Translate rotating machinery and condition monitoring requirements into technical proposals, system architectures, feasibility studies, system sizing, and technical solutions using proprietary sensor and monitoring product lines.*      Coordinate technical input between customers, sales teams, distributors, OEMs, and local R\&D/Product Management teams in Fribourg; deliver technical presentations and solution explanations.*      Support sales teams, distributors, and OEMs during customer discussions, new projects, and retrofit or modernization opportunities, including management of technical inquiries through the Customer Service Desk or Salesforce in line with defined KPIs.*      Support project engineering teams during project execution, technical clarifications, Pre\-FAT, and FAT activities, ensuring customer requirements are understood and implemented.*      Deliver advanced technical training and prepare customer\-facing and internal documentation, including commissioning records, intervention reports, and technical summaries.*      Support investigation, testing, validation, and internal simulation activities related to customer issues, product behavior, and application performance; provide structured field feedback to R\&D/Product Management.**Who we are looking for***      Degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Microengineering, Automation, Systems, Mechatronics, or equivalent.*      Minimum 5 years of experience in application engineering, field service, commissioning, troubleshooting, and customer support within an industrial environment.*      Experience in the energy sector or other industrial environments is an asset (Aerospace, heavy machinery or equivalent).*      Strong technical knowledge of vibration monitoring, condition monitoring, rotating machinery, sensors, protection racks, and related software. Good understanding of signal processing, vibration analysis, electronics, and industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, Profibus, Profinet, and OPC. Vibration Analyst Category 2 certification is considered a strong asset*      Excellent communication and interpersonal skills*      Strong customer\-focused approach, curious and hands\-on*      Professional fluency in English; French and/or German considered as a strong asset*      Willingness to travel up to 30% of the time**What we offer***      Solid employer on the market for over 100 years, we manage the full product lifecycle and support leading aerospace and energy companies worldwide*      Career growth, opportunities and training: we hire from within!*      Collaborative and empowered work environment where team spirit is at the center of our success.*      Company values that encourage trust, respect, collaboration and professional growth.*      Open environment: we are excited to hear your ideas!*      Attractive compensation packages designed to hire and retain the best talents in the industry.*      Company restaurant and other benefitsIf you don’t find yourself in all points, apply anyways, because all competencies are valued!Have we sparked your interest?We look forward to getting to know you!Please apply with your complete application documents directly online.If you are selected for a first interview, we will arrange a meeting on Teams.Some stages of the recruiting process will include professional situational exercises.Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted for the next steps in the recruitment process.*Parker is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on grounds of age, race, religion, ethnic origin, gender, sexual orientation or disability in relation to recruitment and employment*.*Parker Hannifin EMEA Sàrl (“PHEMEA”), based in Etoy, Switzerland, is the Principal Operating Company for Parker in the EMEA region. It is supported by a network of Parker Manufacturing Divisions and Sales Company Entities. The Aerospace Group EMEA is a strategic business Group within PHEMEA, and its Motion, Power, and Sensing Division is a key service provider to PHEMEA.*jpid38cd026jm jpit1146jm jpiy26jm

title: Art Advisor
description: About HELVETIKA 1575HELVETIKA 1575 AG is a contemporary art gallery based in Zug, with a new gallery space opening on Rennweg in Zurich. We represent a deliberately small and selective group of international artists and offer selected secondary\-market works to private collectors, family offices and institutions.We are looking for an Art Advisor (Sales) who builds lasting collector relationships and drives sales actively – through personal networks, outreach and follow\-up, not walk\-in traffic.The role**Position:** Art Advisor (Sales)  **Location:** Zurich, Switzerland  **Workload:** 100%  **Start date:** by arrangement  **Reports to:** Management (Stephan Jöbstl, Katerina Maliakina)  **Compensation:** Fixed salary plus sales commissionYou are responsible for generating revenue: you identify and win collectors, advise them on acquisitions from our programme and inventory, and take each sale through to delivery and after\-sales service.Key responsibilities* Build and manage a portfolio of private collectors, family offices, corporate collections and art advisors* Actively prospect new clients through your network, events, art fairs and structured outreach, with consistent follow\-up* Advise clients on acquisitions of primary works by our artists and selected secondary\-market works* Prepare tailored offers, proposals and presentations, and negotiate sales within agreed price parameters* Manage the full sales process: invoicing, KYC/AML documentation, payment, shipping, installation and after\-sales service* Organise private viewings, studio visits and collector events in Zurich and abroad* Represent the gallery at art fairs and openings* Maintain the CRM with all client contacts, offers and sales, and report pipeline and results in the weekly team meetingQualifications* A completed university degree in Art History, Art Business, Business Administration or a related field – or German is a strong advantage, French, Russian or other languages a plus* Excellent communication and negotiation skills, discretion and a confident, professional presence* Self\-driven, results\-oriented and well organised; experience with CRM tools* Willingness to travel (art fairs, client visits)What we offer* A fixed salary plus an attractive, performance\-based commission on sales* A curated programme of internationally recognised artists and high\-quality secondary\-market works* Direct collaboration with the founders and short decision paths* A new gallery space in the heart of ZurichHow to applyPlease apply online with your CV, a short cover letter and an overview of your sales experience. All applications will be treated confidentially.j4id10475536jm j4it1146jm j4iy26jm

title: Responsable des relevés et décomptes
description: Responsable des relevés et décomptes  Introduction  Nous donnons un avenir aux maisons. Nous le faisons avec des produits et services qui aident à réduire les émissions de CO2 des bâtiments. Pour ce faire, nous gérons des données et des processus permettant de rendre les propriétés plus écologiques, sûres et confortables. La base de nos produits et services est numérique. Nous veillons à faciliter la transition vers nos technologies durables pour tous. Ainsi, nous permettons à chaque personne de contribuer à la protection du climat.  Nous avons déjà déployé plus de 48 millions d'appareils connectés dans le monde et développons des solutions pour des bâtiments écoénergétiques et résilients. Nous employons plus de 6 600 personnes dans 21 pays et nos produits et services sont utilisés dans plus de 14 millions de logements et bâtiments commerciaux dans le monde, chez plus de 460 000 clients. En 2025, le groupe ista élargi a généré un chiffre d'affaires de 1'287 millions d'euros.  Pour renforcer notre équipe en Suisse, nous recherchons un·e Responsable des relevés et décomptes motivé·e et engagé·e.  Ce qui t'attend chez nous  En tant que Responsable du suivi administratif et de la gestion des consommations, tu joueras un rôle essentiel dans notre structure. Tes missions principales:  Calcul des consommations: Tu analyses les relevés de consommation et établis les décomptes individuels de chauffage et d’eau chaude destinés aux propriétaires, gérances et locataires.  Relation client: Tu es en contact direct avec nos clients et tu assures un accueil téléphonique de qualité.  Collaboration: Tu travailles de manière autonome tout en coordonnant avec les gérances et/ou les propriétaires.  Polyvalence: Tu prends part à d’autres tâches administratives selon les besoins.  Ce poste est fait pour toi si :  Tu es titulaire d’un CFC d’employé(e) de commerce.  Tu as plusieurs années d’expérience en comptabilité immobilière, notamment réalisation de décomptes de frais de chauffages et frais accessoires.  Tu es organisé(e), rigoureux(se) et autonome.  Tu aimes les chiffres et tu sais traiter les données avec précision.  Tu sais gérer une charge de travail importante sans compromettre la qualité.  Tu as le sens du service client.  Tu apprécies les contacts avec de nombreux interlocuteurs et gardes ton calme même lorsque les délais sont serrés.  Tu apprécies le travail en équipe.  Tu maîtrises les outils informatiques nécessaires dans un environnement numérique.  Tu parles aussi l’allemand au moins niveau B2 ? C’est un critère indispensable !  Tu parles aussi l’anglais ? C’est un atout !  Ce que nous t'offrons  De nombreuses opportunités et possibilités de faire bouger les choses activement et d'y contribuer.  Une activité variée, exigeante et autonome au sein d'une entreprise à envergure internationale.  Des conditions d'engagement attractives et des perspectives de développement à long terme.  De très bonnes offres pour ton perfectionnement personnel et professionnel.  Un environnement de travail performant et agréable au sein d'une équipe qui vise ensemble le succès.  Une organisation du travail flexible, adaptée à tes besoins.  Envie de nous rejoindre ?  Alors nous nous réjouissons de faire ta connaissance. Postule dès maintenant en ligne. jpid5eeeeb5jm jpit0937jm jpiy26jm

Vous coordonnez également les ressources nécessaires lors de travaux et d'événements, dans le respect du budget alloué, et assurez l'intégration des horaires correspondants dans les systèmes métier. Vous contribuez au suivi de l'activité en établissant les décomptes et statistiques mensuels relatifs aux heures de travail, aux kilomètres et aux ressources humaines, tout en veillant à la qualité des données et du reporting. Au quotidien, vous organisez les remplacements en cas d’absence et traitez les demandes de compensations, d’échanges et de congés.Vous coordonnez également les ressources nécessaires lors de travaux et d’événements, dans le respect du budget alloué, et assurez l’intégration des horaires correspondants dans les systèmes métier. Vous contribuez au suivi de l’activité en établissant les décomptes et statistiques mensuels relatifs aux heures de travail, aux kilomètres et aux ressources humaines, tout en veillant à la qualité des données et du reporting.Dans une démarche d’amélioration continue, vous participez à la mise à jour des processus et de la documentation ainsi qu’au maintien et à l’évolution des outils métier, en collaboration avec les différents services de l’entreprise.Grâce à votre polyvalence, vous êtes également amené·e à assurer la suppléance du ou de la spécialiste planification de l’offre et des ressources pour la planification annuelle et les adaptations de l’offre en cours d’année. Vous apportez votre soutien à la préparation des ressources nécessaires aux travaux et événements et assurez la suppléance principale du coordinateur information voyageurs.**Ce poste est fait pour vous si…**• Vous êtes titulaire d’un CFC d’agent·e de transports publics ou d’une formation équivalente.• Vous disposez d’une expérience en planification du personnel, en répartition et en gestion des absences dans les transports publics.• Vous maîtrisez la LDT et l’OLDT.• Vous utilisez avec aisance les outils usuels de planification et les logiciels bureautiques et êtes disposé·e à vous former aux applications spécifiques à notre activité.• Vous vous exprimez avec aisance en français, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.• Vous avez le sens des priorités et gérez les imprévus avec calme et rigueur.• Vous alliez esprit d’équipe, écoute et diplomatie et traitez les demandes avec équité.• Vous êtes fiable et discret·ète et respectez la confidentialité des données, la sécurité et la sûreté.**Type de contrat :** CDI  **Entrée en fonction :** dès que possible![Compagnie du chemin de fer Nyon-St-Cergue-Morez SA]()* Compagnie du chemin de fer Nyon\-St\-Cergue\-Morez SA  Rue de la Gare 45  1260 Nyon*jid22a71eejm jit1146jm jiy26jm

title: Comptable immobilier confirmé-e
description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Comptable immobilier confirmé-e --- Comptable immobilier confirmé\\-e ================================= ### Introduction Gérances de Luze est une gérance immobilière familiale fondée en 1973 et implantée à Morges. Nous accompagnons les propriétaires et les locataires dans la gestion administrative et technique de portefeuilles résidentiels et commerciaux, ainsi que dans la location, la vente et l'expertise immobilière. Notre équipe d'une dizaine de collaborateurs intervient dans la région morgienne et sur l'arc lémanique avec proximité, discrétion et rigueur. ### Responsabilités En tant que Comptable immobilier confirmé\\-e, vous prenez en charge la comptabilité d'un portefeuille immobilier et contribuez à la fiabilité du suivi financier des immeubles, en collaboration avec les équipes de gérance. \* Tenir la comptabilité des immeubles et des copropriétés afin de garantir des comptes exacts et à jour. \* Enregistrer et contrôler les factures, encaissements, paiements et écritures comptables afin d'assurer un suivi financier fiable des propriétaires, locataires et fournisseurs. \* Effectuer les rapprochements bancaires et analyser les mouvements comptables afin d'identifier et de corriger rapidement les écarts. \* Préparer les décomptes de charges, les comptes de gestion et les bouclements afin de fournir une information financière claire aux propriétaires. \* Suivre les débiteurs et les créanciers afin de soutenir une gestion saine des liquidités et des obligations financières. \* Participer à la préparation des budgets, au contrôle des charges et au suivi de la rentabilité des immeubles afin d'appuyer les décisions de gestion. \* Répondre aux demandes comptables des propriétaires, locataires, fournisseurs et collègues afin de maintenir un service précis et de proximité. \* Utiliser un logiciel comptable immobilier et des outils bureautiques afin de structurer les données, produire les rapports et sécuriser les processus comptables. ### Qualifications Nous recherchons une personne expérimentée en comptabilité immobilière, capable de gérer ses dossiers avec autonomie tout en collaborant étroitement avec une équipe à taille humaine. \* Expérience confirmée dans la comptabilité immobilière, la comptabilité de gérance ou un domaine comparable. \* Formation en comptabilité, gestion immobilière ou domaine équivalent. \* Maîtrise des opérations de comptabilité générale, du suivi des débiteurs et créanciers, des rapprochements bancaires et des bouclements. \* Bonne compréhension des décomptes de charges, des budgets d'immeubles et du suivi financier de portefeuilles immobiliers. \* Aisance avec un logiciel de comptabilité et les outils bureautiques pour saisir, contrôler et analyser les données financières. \* Rigueur, sens de l'organisation et attention aux détails afin de traiter plusieurs dossiers avec fiabilité. \* Autonomie dans l'exécution des tâches et aptitude à communiquer clairement avec les propriétaires, locataires, fournisseurs et collègues. ### Benefits Nous vous proposons de rejoindre une entreprise familiale stable, active depuis plus de 50 ans au cœur de Morges, au sein d'une équipe d'une dizaine de collaborateurs expérimentés. Nous privilégions un contact direct, une gestion sur mesure et un environnement de travail fondé sur la proximité, l'engagement et le professionnalisme. ### Application Nous vous invitons à postuler directement via cette annonce afin de rejoindre Gérances de Luze comme Comptable immobilier confirmé\\-e. !\[Gérances de Luze \]( ) \* Gérances de Luze Place Dufour 1 1110 Morges \* \[ \](\< \>) jpida021fffjm jpit1146jm jpiy26jm

title: Legal Advisor - Commodities Trade Finance + Wealth Management

description: Rieter is the world’s leading system supplier for processing natural and man\-made fibers into short\-staple and long\-staple yarn, as well as for the production of filament yarns, man\-made fibers and nonwovens. Rieter’s leading technologies ensure minimal resource consumption, making a significant contribution to sustainability across the global textile value chain. skills, as required by management.Your Profile* 5\+ years SAP Technical Service Deliver lead experience* Strong technical expertise in SAP RISE, SAP Cloud ALM, SAP For Me, SAP BTP and ITSM.* Expert in Hinter den Kulissen entsteht hier die Grundlage für Genuss auf konstant hohem Niveau.**Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir nach einem Chef de Partie (m/w/d)****In der vielseitigen und verantwortungsvollen Funktion als Chef de Partie (m/w/d) gehören folgende Tätigkeiten zu Ihrem Aufgabenbereich:**- Vorbereitung und Produktion von Speisen für Bankette, Events, Buffets und Veranstaltungen unterschiedlicher Grössenordnungen- Fachgerechte Umsetzung der Rezepturen, Portionierungen und Vorgaben zum Anrichten der Speisen für die Les Trois Rois Bar- Gewährleistung einer einwandfreien Küchenabläufe sowie einer reibungslosen Vorbereitung und Service-Nachbereitung- Kontrolle der angerichteten Speisen am Posten hinsichtlich Geschmack, Qualität und Optik- Ermittlung des Lebensmittelbedarfs sowie Aufnahme und Weiterleitung der Warenbestellungen- Entgegennahme, Kontrolle und fachgerechte Verräumung der Lebensmittel- Erstellung von Menüvorschlägen und Tagesmenüs in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Vorgesetzten- Sicherstellung einer konstant hohen Qualität und optimalen Zubereitung der Speisen- Umsetzung und Kontrolle der hotelspezifischen Standards sowie der Vorgaben des Qualitätsmanagements- Einhaltung der geltenden Hygienevorschriften und Lebensmittelgesetze**Mit folgenden Eigenschaften überzeugen Sie uns:**- Eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung in der Hotellerie oder Gastronomie als Koch/Köchin mit anschliessender einschlägiger Berufserfahrung- Fundierte Kenntnisse in Hygiene, HACCP sowie Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards; entsprechende Hygieneschulungen von Vorteil- Interesse an der Einarbeitung von Mitarbeitenden, Lernenden und Trainees, sowie erste Führungserfahrung- Strukturierte, sorgfältige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise sowie hohe Belastbarkeit und Flexibilität- Teamorientierte, lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit mit sicherem und professionellem Auftreten sowie guten Kommunikations- und Durchsetzungsfähigkeiten- Gute Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch, weitere Sprachen wie Englisch und Französisch sind von Vorteil**Wir bieten:**- Ein dynamisches und motiviertes Team, das viel Freude an den Aufgaben hat- Ein lebendiges Umfeld in einem der führenden Häuser der Schweizer Luxushotellerie- Spezialpreise für Übernachtungen in den Häusern der Swiss Deluxe Hotels- Mitarbeiter- sowie Family & Friends-Vorteile im Les Trois Rois- Tolle Vergünstigungen z.B. 30% in der hoteleigenen Blumenboutique Fleurs des Rois- Europa Park-Vergünstigungen- Zentraler Arbeitsort direkt in der Basler Altstadt- Neu eröffnetes Mitarbeiterrestaurant mit Blick auf den RheinMöchten Sie Teil dieses motivierten Teams werden? Dann bewerben Sie sich noch heute. Wir freuen uns auf Sie!**Willkommen im Grand Hotel Les Trois Rois!**Das Grand Hotel Les Trois Rois in Basel zählt mit seiner fast 350-jährigen Geschichte zu den traditionsreichsten Hotels Europas. Direkt am Rhein und im Herzen der Basler Altstadt gelegen, vereint es historischen Charme mit zeitloser Eleganz. Unter dem Motto «Rich in History, Young at Heart» verfolgt das Haus das Ziel, höchste Ansprüche zu erfüllen und seinen Gästen unvergessliche Erlebnisse zu bereiten. In 82 stilvoll ausgestatteten Zimmern und Suiten geniessen die Gäste exklusiven Komfort und gelebte Gastfreundschaft.Kulinarisch überzeugt das Grand Hotel Les Trois Rois mit einem vielseitigen Angebot: dem Gourmet-Restaurant Cheval Blanc by Peter Knogl, ausgezeichnet mit drei Michelin-Sternen, 19 GaultMillau-Punkten und 2025 von La Liste auf Platz 1 der weltbesten Restaurants geführt, der Brasserie Les Trois Rois mit 15 GaultMillau-Punkten sowie einer eleganten Bar mit preisgekrönten Cocktails.Ein neues Kapitel der Hotelgeschichte wurde mit dem von Herzog & de Meuron umgebauten Kopfgebäude aufgeschlagen. Entstanden sind neue Zimmer und Suiten, wandelbare Eventräume, das Restaurant Banks – Basels neuer Treffpunkt mit europäisch-asiatischer Küche und Sharing-Konzept – sowie der japanisch inspirierte Wellbeing-Bereich Seijaku, eine Oase der Ruhe inmitten der Stadt.

title: Chief Executive Officer (CEO) – Asset & Wealth Management (100%)
description: Chief Executive Officer (CEO) – Asset & Wealth Management (100%)Pfäffikon SZ, SwitzerlandAbout the Company:We are an internationally focused Swiss asset management company based in the Canton of Schwyz. As an asset manager within the meaning of the Swiss Financial Institutions Act (FinIA), we provide our clients with asset management, financial advisory and related financial services.We operate in an international environment and act both on our own account and on behalf of third parties. In doing so, we combine financial expertise with an entrepreneurial approach to identifying and developing investment opportunities.As we enter the next phase of our corporate development, we are seeking an accomplished and internationally experienced Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to lead the company, strengthen the existing business and drive strategic expansion into new markets and investment sectors, with a primary focus on Life Sciences (particularly artificial intelligence) and international markets – with an emphasis on the United Kingdom, Asia and Eastern Europe.Your Role:As CEO, you will have overall responsibility for the strategic, operational and commercial development of the company. Working closely with the Board of Directors, shareholders and other senior stakeholders, you will define and implement the corporate strategy and lead the continued development of the company as an internationally focused Swiss asset manager.You will combine strong leadership and investment expertise with entrepreneurial thinking, extensive transaction experience and a deep understanding of international financial markets.How You Will Contribute to Our Success:•    Assume overall responsibility for the strategic, operational and commercial management of the company and translate its long-term vision into measurable business objectives.•    Identify, assess and develop new markets, with a focus on the United Kingdom, Asia and Eastern Europe, as well as investment opportunities and strategic partnerships in the Life Sciences sector (particularly artificial intelligence).•    Drive fundraising initiatives and further expand the company’s international investor and business network, particularly in the United Kingdom, Asia and Eastern Europe, within the aforementioned financial sectors.•    Lead and oversee investment activities across asset and portfolio management, corporate finance, M&A, private equity and fundraising.•    Lead, develop and support the management team and employees, while establishing a culture of excellence, accountability, integrity and entrepreneurial thinking.Requirements:•    A university degree (Master) with excellent academic results from a top-tier university in Life Science Entrepreneurship.•    Strong industry knowledge and relevant professional experience in Life Sciences and AI, including the ability to assess companies, technologies, markets and investment opportunities in these sectors.•    Several years of international leadership experience in the financial sector, ideally in asset or wealth management, investment management, private equity, corporate finance, investment banking or a comparable environment.•    A proven track record in several of the following areas: corporate finance and financial analysis, M&A and transaction execution, fundraising, private equity, portfolio management and investment management, with a particular focus on Life Sciences (especially artificial intelligence).•    A demonstrated ability to identify and develop new markets and business opportunities and to translate strategic opportunities into sustainable commercial growth – preferably with leadership experience in Asia and the United Kingdom.•    Excellent communication, representation and negotiation skills, together with the ability to build trusted relationships with boards of directors, shareholders, investors, clients and other senior stakeholders.•    A high degree of integrity, discretion, resilience and sound judgement, including when handling confidential information and complex decisions.•    Languages: English and Russian.•    Willingness to be based in Switzerland for this role.What We Offer:•    A top-level executive position with overall responsibility for an internationally focused Swiss asset management company.•    The opportunity to play a significant role in shaping the company’s strategic direction and to lead it through its next phase of growth and international development.•    A central role in expanding the company’s activities in some of the most dynamic investment sectors, particularly Life Sciences (artificial intelligence).•    A high degree of responsibility and autonomy in developing new markets, investment opportunities and strategic partnerships in the aforementioned area, particularly in the United Kingdom, Asia and Eastern Europe.•    Close collaboration with the Board of Directors, shareholders, investors and senior stakeholders across the Swiss and international financial ecosystem.•    A professional, ethical and performanceoriented working environment that encourages initiative, accountability and long-term professional development.Interested?If you are an internationally experienced financial services executive with a strong investment and transaction background and the ambition to help shape the future of an entrepreneurial asset management company, we look forward to hearing from you.We look forward to receiving your application, including your CV and relevant supporting documents, by email to:Markus Marthalercontact@golden-hawk-invest.com

Minergie ist der Schweizer Baustandard für Komfort, Effizienz und Klimaschutz und setzt seit 1998 Massstäbe für zukunftsfähige Gebäude.Das GEAK‑Tool ist die digitale Plattform zur Erstellung der Gebäudeenergieausweise. title: Field Application Engineer
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Field Application Engineer---Field Application Engineer==========================  **Are you ready to shape a brighter future?** Did you know that every second, an aircraft takes off somewhere in the world, and that 90% of them are equipped with a component produced in Fribourg? We are Hannifin, a global leader in motion and control technologies, with more than 58,000 team members across 44 countries. Our Business Unit in Fribourg, Switzerland, part of the Motion, Power, and Sensing division, is a technological and manufacturing center of excellence specializing in the development and production of measurement, control, and protection solutions for the aerospace and energy sectors. With around 400 employees, we design, qualify, and manufacture high\-performance sensors, electronic systems, and software monitoring solutions for critical and extreme environments. We are proud to work with passion, to enable engineering breakthrough and innovation. Joining Fribourg means contributing to high\-value international technology projects, growing in a collaborative and innovative environment, and developing your full professional and personal potential.  **Your responsibilities***       Perform on\-site installation, wiring verification, configuration, functional testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of vibration monitoring systems, sensors, protection racks, and related software; resolve hardware, software, and industrial networking issues at customer sites.  *       Coordinate with customer site personnel to confirm requirements and site readiness, apply applicable safety standards and site rules, and prepare field service reports, troubleshooting summaries, and root\-cause analysis logs.  *       Translate rotating machinery and condition monitoring requirements into technical proposals, system architectures, feasibility studies, system sizing, and technical solutions using proprietary sensor and monitoring product lines.  *       Coordinate technical input between customers, sales teams, distributors, OEMs, and local R\&D/Product Management teams in Fribourg; deliver technical presentations and solution explanations.  *       Support sales teams, distributors, and OEMs during customer discussions, new projects, and retrofit or modernization opportunities, including management of technical inquiries through the Customer Service Desk or Salesforce in line with defined KPIs.  *       Support project engineering teams during project execution, technical clarifications, Pre\-FAT, and FAT activities, ensuring customer requirements are understood and implemented.  *       Deliver advanced technical training and prepare customer\-facing and internal documentation, including commissioning records, intervention reports, and technical summaries.  *       Support investigation, testing, validation, and internal simulation activities related to customer issues, product behavior, and application performance; provide structured field feedback to R\&D/Product Management.    **Who we are looking for***       Degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Microengineering, Automation, Systems, Mechatronics, or equivalent.  *       Minimum 5 years of experience in application engineering, field service, commissioning, troubleshooting, and customer support within an industrial environment.  *       Experience in the energy sector or other industrial environments is an asset (Aerospace, heavy machinery or equivalent).  *       Strong technical knowledge of vibration monitoring, condition monitoring, rotating machinery, sensors, protection racks, and related software. understanding of signal processing, vibration analysis, electronics, and industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, Profibus, Profinet, and OPC. Vibration Analyst Category 2 certification is considered a strong asset  *       Excellent communication and interpersonal skills  *       Strong customer\-focused approach, curious and hands\-on  *       Professional fluency in English; French and/or considered as a strong asset  *       Willingness to travel up to 30% of the time    **What we offer***       Solid employer on the market for over 100 years, we manage the full product lifecycle and support leading aerospace and energy companies worldwide  *       Career growth, opportunities and training: we hire from within!  *       Collaborative and empowered work environment where team spirit is at the center of our success.  *       Company values that encourage trust, respect, collaboration and professional growth.  *       Open environment: we are excited to hear your ideas!  *       Attractive compensation packages designed to hire and retain the best talents in the industry.  *       Company restaurant and other benefits    If you don’t find yourself in all points, apply anyways, because all competencies are valued! Have we sparked your interest? We look forward to getting to know you!  Please apply with your complete application documents directly online. If you are selected for a first interview, we will arrange a meeting on Teams. Some stages of the recruiting process will include professional situational exercises.   Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted for the next steps in the recruitment process.   *is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on grounds of age, race, religion, ethnic origin, gender, sexual orientation or disability in relation to recruitment and employment* .  *Hannifin EMEA Sàrl (“PHEMEA”), based in Etoy, Switzerland, is the Principal Operating Company for in the EMEA region. title: Content & Product Specialist
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Content &amp; Product Specialist---Content \& Product Specialist=============================  ***Dear applicants, you have an assignment to complete at the bottom of this job add.***  ***Applications will not be considered if not complete.*** Definition of function and missionClinique La Prairie is a science\-based longevity company. Its value comes from turning medical innovation into programmes that people can understand, trust and book. As Product Content \& Education Specialist, you will know that science and that offer better than anyone outside the medical team. You will turn them into the content every team uses to explain the offer, sell it and prove it.This is a hands\-on expert role, built on writing and product knowledge. You write most of what you deliver yourself: brochures, web and sales copy, scripts, training content and briefs. Your value comes from how deeply you know the product and how well you write.The role sits in Strategic \& Product Marketing and reports to the Head of Strategic \& Product Marketing. On one side are Innovation and Medical; on the other are , Digital, PR, APAC and the properties. Product creates the content and those teams use it. Your work covers the whole guest journey, from the first video a prospect sees to the brochure a sales advisor sends and the e\-learning module a new team member completes.In 2027, CLP's priority is to own scientific and medical excellence in longevity. No competitor holds this ground yet, and CLP's programmes and doctors already earn it. Most of the evidence exists inside the company but has not yet been made public. Your mission is to publish it accurately, in the brand's voice, across every destination.The role succeeds when:* Every destination presents the offer the same way, using the latest version.  * Each programme or offer update reaches every material quickly and without errors.  * Public content relies more on science, in line with the 2027 mix for Longevity Talks: 40% science, 30% performance, 30% personalities.  * The content supports the 2027 KPIs: programmes sold and average price in Montreux, content performance, and CLP's share of AI answers on scientific and medical excellence.   ResponsibilitiesA. Product Expertise \& Innovation\-to\-Market *Purpose: be the marketing team's reference on what CLP offers and why it works, and make sure every innovation reaches the market accurately.** Master the full portfolio, by destination (Montreux, Health Resorts, Longevity Hubs): every programme, protocol, pillar, diagnostic and treatment, plus the CLP Method and the science behind it.  * Build and maintain the Product Knowledge Base, with one source of truth per programme: content, duration, price structure, inclusions, approved claims, medical references and differences by destination.  * Build and maintain, with Medical, a library of evidence that can be made public: studies, the scientific committee, doctor profiles, results and data.  * Be marketing's day\-to\-day contact for Innovation and Medical on product content. Follow the innovation pipeline, attend product reviews and learn about changes before they launch.  * Check scientific accuracy and claims with Medical, and with Legal where needed, before any content is published.  * For each programme or offer change, list every affected asset (brochures, toolkit, e\-learning, website, guest communications) and track it until all are updated.  * Write the launch package for each new programme or update: key messages, sales narrative, FAQs and internal briefing.  * Answer product questions from , Digital, PR, Regional teams and the properties.  * Provide verified product and scientific content for the website and its knowledge base.   B. Offer \& Content ( \& Marketing Enabling Toolkit) *Purpose: give and every property the tools to present one standard offer and to hold a consultative, client\-led conversation.** Write and maintain the content of the \& Marketing Enabling Toolkit, covering Global , Health Resorts, Longevity Hubs and internal enablement. Keep its SharePoint structure and version control up to date.  * Write and update brochures, one\-pagers, commercial fact sheets and programme summaries, all built on one standard offer across Resorts and Hubs.  * Write pre\-booking templates, welcome communications and guest preparation materials.  * Prepare the content package for new openings, such as the upcoming Longevity Hub in New York  * Send each update to the markets with a short note on what changed, and withdraw outdated versions.   C. The scope may later extend to newsletter strategy.  * Write background content on programmes, experts and CLP's scientific credentials to support PR.  * Brief regional adaptations so that each market has relevant proof, voices and language versions.  * Give product and scientific input to brand campaigns and video productions.   D.
